A new director tests the team as he tries to bring real magic to Hogwarts, as well as a new Dumbledore. But will Harry Potter survive this new dark tone?

The Potter machine starts to go off the rails as the new director struggles to master the new technology. With the film still incomplete producers pull the plug and one crew member leaves the franchise for good.
As the franchise grows more adult, fame starts to take a toll on the stars. With the kids struggling to grow up and yet another new director at the helm, will Harry Potter lose the magic?
As the franchise comes down to its final test, making two movies for the price of one, an accident changes one crew member’s life forever

James Bond began with real life spy and anxious bridegroom, Ian Fleming. But it would take a bumpy road to bring this spy story to the screen. An unlikely team finds an unknown Scottish actor and faces down a troubled production to change cinema forever.

Despite their wild success the cracks begin to show. With the departure of their star, Cubby Broccoli and Harry Saltzman must find a new actor to play the super-spy, adding tension to a strained relationship. How disastrous can their new choice be?

Though diamonds may be forever, Connery wasn’t. The producers need a new star and their choice revolutionizes the character. Embracing the cultural changes of the 70s takes Bond to new heights, but for one producer it would be the end of an era.

With an aging actor in the lead and a new director in charge, the Battle of the Bonds divides the franchise before a new gritty take on the character nearly drives it to ruin. But it's the studio that threatens to deliver the finishing blow to Bond.

With the troubles of the 80s behind them, is there a place for Bond in the modern world? With a new generation of producers in charge and the fate of the studio in their hands, can Pierce Brosnan defy expectations and revitalize the franchise?

Producers make a risky bet and forgo the tried-and-true formula. Acquiring the long-estranged film rights to Fleming’s first novel, Casino Royale, they recast Bond with the least likely actor imagined and see if they can reinvent the spy one more time.
As a broke video store clerk with an encyclopedic knowledge of film, young gun Quentin Tarantino tries to turn his heist script, Reservoir Dogs, into a 50,000-dollar movie.

Hot off his indie hit Reservoir Dogs, Quentin Tarantino faces rising expectations. In response, he doubles down on his trademarks - pushing the violence, drug use, and bold, nonlinear storytelling further with his sophomore smash-hit, Pulp Fiction.
Now with an Oscar under his belt and more popularity than he could’ve imagined, those same studios that once passed on Tarantino’s scripts scramble to do business with him.

Rooted in their love of kung-fu movies, Tarantino and Uma Thurman come up with a revenge saga inspired by martial arts and exploitation cinema that took nearly 10 years to fully realize. Thus, was born Kill Bill, Tarantino’s most ambitious movie yet.
After years of failed attempts, Quentin Tarantino finally cracks his long-gestating World War II film that would become Inglourious Basterds.

p.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Garry Newlove
p.d: Garry Newlove’s wife Helen talks about the events on the night of his murder and the days afterwards, as well as her current work as a peer in the House of Lords combatting anti-social behaviour.

p.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Peter Sutcliffe
p.d: Arguably Britain's most infamous serial killer, Peter Sutcliffe became known as The Yorkshire Ripper when he began murdering women in Yorkshire during the 1970s.

p.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Far From Home: Kyu Soo Kim
p.d: Robbie Coltrane examines the harrowing case of a London landlord who sadistically tortured and murdered two of his tenants.

p.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: The Saturday Night Strangler: Joe Kappen
p.d: In 1973, three young girls were beaten, raped and strangled over a six-week period. The Saturday Night Strangler escaped justice for almost 30 years. But new techniques in DNA technology and a midnight exhumation finally uncovered the killer.

p.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: The Double Axe Murderer: Dennis Smalley
p.d: A double axe murderer and no clues - except tiny flakes of paint discovered deep in the wounds of one of the victims. This is a story of how forensic science - and the determination of one detective - found the killer.

p.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Into Thin Air: David Gilroy
p.d: It was a missing person’s case that shook the people of Scotland to their core. Within a week of Suzanne Pilley disappearing from her place of work in Edinburgh, police were convinced they were hunting for a killer - despite not having found a body.

p.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Dead Man's Hollow: Nishan Bakunts
p.d: In 2002, an off-duty fireman discovered a body in a field charred beyond all recognition. All the police knew was that the man had died a brutal death, having been stabbed repeatedly, shot in the head, and drenched in petrol before being set alight.

p.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Time Of Death: Albert Walker
p.d: When a Devonshire fisherman hauled in his nets on July 28 1996, he made a gruesome discovery: among that day’s catch was a dead body. There was nothing to identify the man’s body except a Rolex watch and a small maple leaf tattoo on his hand.

At the age of 25, Mark Martin murdered three young women in Nottingham city centre in the winter of 2004-2005. Since his teens, Mark Martin had been fixated on serial killers, and had an ambition to become Nottingham’s first serial killer.
Glyn Dix shot dead his landlady in 1979. While serving a life sentence he met and fell in love with a fellow inmate’s mother. They married, but three years after his release he killed his wife.

James Fairweather was a 15-year-old boy obsessed with serial killers, violent video games and extreme pornography. He stabbed two strangers to death in separate attacks. He was found unanimously guilty by a jury on 22 April 2016.
Sana Muhammad, formerly known as Devi, had left her unhappy arranged marriage to Ramanodge Unmathallegadoo and remarried. She was a pregnant mother of five when he murdered her in her home.
Stephen Port was convicted of the assaults, rapes and murders of Anthony Walgate, Gabriel Kovari, Daniel Whitworth and Jack Taylor. He was sentenced to life imprisonment with a whole life order.

In the small rural town of Fayette, Maine, Ted Flagg returns to his newly purchased home to find his wife Judith stabbed to death. Investigators struggle to find suspects and the case is left unanswered for the next 23 years.

In the small town of Ozark, Alabama, Tracy Harris’ body is found strangled to death and dumped in the local river. With the obvious suspect being her abusive ex-husband, investigators struggle to link him to the murder and the case goes cold.
Ironside investigates the fatal shooting of the son of Fran's divorced friend (Mary Ure); guests Clu Gulager, Herb Edelman.
Ironside has a chance encounter with an old flame (Dana Wynter) who plans to steal a jade tiger the chief is guarding.
A badly beaten attorney (James Olson) describes an unconscious man aboard a sinking boat.
A top-security scientist disappears and Ironside discovers an unexplained $50,000 in his bank account.
A couple (Sharon Gless, Russell Wiggins) disappears while throwing a haunted house party in an abandoned mansion.
Ironside is accidentally tipped to an organization that is illegally supplying Mexican domestics to U.S. families.
Ironside pretends to quit the force and poses as a Skid Row derelict to trap a killer; guest Kim Darby.
A nightclub psychic (Ross Martin) knows more than the newspapers about a fatal fire; guest Louise Sorel.
Vengeful mobsters stalk an ex-POW (Cliff Potts) searching frantically for his supposedly dead police-officer father.
A paid informant's (Allen Garfield) cover is blown, endangering his wife and daughter; guests Albert Salmi, Nancy Malone.
After a friend is beaten, Mark is the bait to trap the attackers' loan-shark boss; guests Scatman Crothers, Albert Popwell.
Lt. Reese falls under suspicion after the disappearance of heroin intended as evidence against a mob boss.
A con artist (Michael Bell) kidnaps a captured bank robber's (Paul Burke) child and demands the loot as ransom.
The martial-arts murder of a Chinatown elder leads Ironside to a larcenous youth gang; guests Benson Fong, Frank Michael Liu, Mako.
An invitation to Ironside's class reunion contains one classmate's suggestion that her husband was murdered; guest Anne Francis.

p.t: JAG: The Bridge At Kang So Ri
p.d: Harm and Mac board a plane bound for Korea to investigate charges that GI's shot and killed civilians during the Korean War.
Mac is prosecuting a SEAL jumpmaster charged with causing the death of one of his men during a parachute insertion exercise.
Medal of Honor Navy SEAL Lt. Curtis Rivers is court-martialed for punching a Congressional candidate who claims to be a Navy SEAL.
A salvage company tries to claim rights to the wreckage of the USS Dolphin, a WW2 submarine that was lost the day before the attack on Pearl Harbor in 1941.

Louis Cellucci is having a rough time aboard the flight deck of the USS Benjamin Harrison. Moments after he walks away from another failed attempt at fixing an F-14, shouts of Man Overboard! are heard across the deck.

Congresswoman Latham and a colleague watch four marine jumpers jump into the ocean from an M22 Osprey. With two marines left to jump, the plane is struck by a swell in the ocean. Harm and Mac are instructed to investigate.
When Captain Huddleston hears that the marine corporal has been charged with rape, he sends Lt. Colonel Sarah Mac MacKenzie to handle the case in a hot zone of Anti-American activity.

An intruder shoots three Navy people, killing two. One of the dead is a friend of Harm, who protects his reputation. Webb, counter-espionage, and disinformation are involved; Bud solves it. Mac and Renee return to town; Mac leaves again.

Capt. Shepard leads his troop off its peacekeeping mission and into battle with the colonel of the rebel forces. Consequently, six marines die in the public incident. Harm is sent in to investigate despite a recent touch of bad luck in a string of trials.

The JAG gang takes part in a JAGathon, a charity-benefit marathon, which provides opportunities for personal pride and individual competitiveness. Sturgis feels uncertain, and Harm defends a sailor for impersonating an officer.

A spotter on the ground calls for an airstrike as he has identified 15 heavily armed suspected Al Qaeda members on horseback. JAG won’t approve the airstrike until the spotter is absolutely certain the men are Al Qaeda members.

An ambulance pulls up to a crash site where a woman, Jennifer Wilson, is found injured and crying for her baby. Unbeknownst to her, the six-month-old baby died in the accident. A Navy judge stands accused of vehicular homicide.

Central Command coordinates an airstrike on a confirmed target traveling through Afghanistan. After the strike is launched, marine troops assess the damage and they are disturbed to learn that they targeted the wrong vehicle and hit civilians instead.

Kabir is preparing an attack against the U.S. and was last seen crossing the border from Afghanistan to Iran. He is believed to have recruited Capt. Yerastov, a Russian submarine captain. Turner, Harm and Mac help in the hunt for the terrorists.

Bud has lost his right lower leg due to a mine in Afghanistan; during emergency surgery he faces bad trouble. Sturgis returns to Washington, and Harm and Mac disobey an order from the admiral. Bud encounters an astounding change of course.

Scott fears he's Lizzie's trick and has a major meltdown leading to their first fight. Meanwhile, at Matt's release, Caitlin inspects her man, and Michael's wife and girlfriend make plans to pick him up from prison.

Matt and Caitlin's sexy reunion leads to a surprising offer. At Tracie's release, Clint fears she's catfishing him, and Brittany walks out on her first date with Marcelino. Sarah picks up Michael from prison, but he's harbouring a scandalous secret.

Ex-con Michael juggles his wife and girlfriend and Lizzie gives Scott a makeover, but her daughter wants him out. Clint proposes the same day he meets Tracie. Caitlin and Matt move in with mother, while Marcelino meets Brittany's bunkmate.
Michael searches for a ring with his wife, but secretly plans to meet up with his girlfriend. Clint and Tracie get married, but Clint wakes up to an unpleasant surprise.
Megan and Michael meet outside of prison for the first time, where wife Sarah shares a surprising secret. Plus, Clint is having a hard time while missing Tracie.
Michael is confronted by his wife about his disappearance. Clint looks for legal help when his wife is locked up, and Jazmyne gives Lizzie an ultimatum.

MacGyver takes custody of an ex-gang member accused of auto theft to save a youth center from its racist opponents.
MacGyver fights to save a young runaway from a life of drug addiction and prostitution.
MacGyver s quest to find buried Russian gold leads him through a maze of harrowing traps.
MacGyver's mountain retreat group is infiltrated by a couple of murderous escaped convicts.
MacGyver unravels an assassination plot against an East African leader after discovering that Jack Dalton has been brainwashed.
MacGyver and Pete Thornton are taken hostage by a group of terrorists threatening to take over a nearby city.
MacGyver is shocked when he learns that the thief who stole a vial of deadly bacteria from the Phoenix Foundation is an old friend who once saved his life.
A newly released convict bent on revenge hunts down MacGyver in the woods, using Pete Thornton and Jack Dalton as bait.
When MacGyver Is wounded during an assassination attempt and subsequently framed as the sniper he must rely on the help of an insecure schoolgirl to save his life and foil the true assassin's plan.
MacGyver joins forces with a bounty hunter in the search for a woman who is the target of jewel thieves.
MacGyver teams up with a female archaeologist, Zoe Ryan, in the search for an ancient artifact known as 'The Holy Rose.'
In their quest for a legendary artifact, MacGyver and archaeologist Zoe Ryan discover the secrets of an ancient utopian society.
MacGyver and bounty hunter Jesse Colton search the streets of Bangkok for Colton's illegitimate son, whom they suspect has information concerning stolen medical supplies.
MacGyver and Murdoc are forced into an uneasy partnership when they must rely on each other's resources in order to rescue a kidnap victim -- Murdoc's sister.
The crew of a DC-9 find themselves in a violent storm. The cockpit windshield shatters. When both engines give out the crew has no option but to put the plane down on a highway.

Air India Flight 182 suddenly disappears from radar. Pieces of the aircraft and bodies are found in the North Atlantic Ocean. All 329 people on board are dead. Air India 182 was brought down by a bomb
Bombarded by confusing alarms, the pilots of Birgenair Flight 301 struggle to regain control. Within five minutes of taking off, the airplane slams into the ocean, killing everyone on board.
Captain Robert Loft decides to have the auto pilot fly the plane in a holding pattern while they work to fix a troublesome bulb. None of the crew notice they are slowly falling, until it’s too late.

A Legacy jet takes-off on its maiden voyage. An hour into the flight a jolt rocks the jet. Another plane has crashed nearby. Everyone on board was killed. The Legacy jet And the 737 collided in mid-air.
Ripped Apart revisits some of the most spectacular aviation disasters of the last fifty years to expose the explosive power of decompression.
Fatal Flaw revisits some of the most troubling aviation disasters ‚ revealing that tiny problems can have deadly consequences.
Who's Flying the Plane? revisits some of the most troubling aviation disasters that resulted from problems with autopilots and computerized systems.
Twenty minutes after taking off from Taipei, a China Airlines 747 suddenly disappears from radar. A massive rescue mission is launched — but all 225 passengers and crew are dead.
Shortly after taking off from Heathrow Airport, Pan Am Flight 103 suddenly explodes in the skies above Lockerbie, Scotland.
On a charter trip from Oslo to Hamburg, Partnair Flight 394 is cruising at 22,000 feet -- when it suddenly begins diving toward the sea.
Saudi Airways Flight 763. One of the most horrifying mid-air collisions in history happened over India in 1996.
An American C-5 Galaxy is flying orphaned Vietnamese babies out of Saigon into safety when things go horribly wrong at 23,000 feet.
Tuninter Flight 1153 is flying to the Tunisian resort island of Djerba. It’s high above the Mediterranean when, suddenly, its right engine fails.
When a Adam Air Flight #574 flies into a storm and crashes into the sea, the investigators cannot believe what actually brought down the aircraft.

Carole and Harry Jarvis were married for over 30 years. But he met a new woman, heiress Rita Heyster, and decided it was time to move on. In a bizarre, twisted scheme, Harry and Rita plotted to murder Carole and cover up her death.

William Walker was a firefighter and paramedic with a reputation for helping strangers. Little wonder that debt-ridden Uloma Curry was attracted to him. Within weeks of their wedding she was plotting to get her hands on his cash.

Micah Rine's family had a bad feeling about Thomas Pate. He seemed inauthentic. He had a troubled past. But nothing could persuade Micah that he wasn't the man of her dreams. By the time Micah realised Thomas had a dark side, it was too late.

Rod Covlin met Shele Danishevsky at a Jewish singles night. She was older, successful and rich, and Rod was happy to live off his wife. After her mysterious death, it seemed he would stop at nothing to get his hands on her money.

From the moment she set eyes on co-worker Charlie Stephens, Kirstin was determined to have him; never mind his 40-year marriage. She seduced him, and in doing so set her husband on the path of financial ruin, deception, and ultimately murder.

When Faye and Marian Caliman first met, she was bowled over by his gentlemanly ways. He was the life and soul of family parties. But when the marriage turned sour, Faye and her family realised Marian was not the true gent he’d always pretended.

Andrew and Janee Parsons’ marriage broke down when she fell for someone new. Still living in the family home, Janee hadn’t reckoned on Andrew’s jealousy and violence - just as he hadn’t realised his horrific actions would all be caught on tape.

Scott Gellatly swept neighbour Lori Jackson off her feet. But her mother Merry had doubts about Scott. He controlled where Lori went, and who she spoke to. So when things turned violent, it wasn’t just Lori in the firing line.

Rhys Hancock was a respected school head; his wife Helen a much-loved PE teacher. When their marriage failed she found love with Martin Griffiths. But Rhys made the choice that ending his wife’s happiness would be worth the long prison sentence.

Heather and Mark Arthur had been married 30 years. But their marriage wasn’t always a happy one: Mark was controlling and jealous, and eventually Heather decided she wanted out. When she confessed to finding new love, Mark’s jealousy boiled over.

Bill Taylor loved wife Angela, even when she left him, even when she met new partner, Paul Cannon. But Angela hated Bill, because he refused to divorce her. The answer, in Angela and Paul’s minds, was to end the marriage by any means necessary.

Greg Williams was Michelle’s knight in shining armour. A mother of three, working in the sex industry, Greg was her ticket to a luxurious life. When an intruder breached their mansion’s security and attacked the couple, detectives were baffled.

Maria Sanutti-Spencer revelled in her dad Rocco’s criminal past, and threatened violent retribution for anyone who crossed her. As her marriage broke down, her husband, Frank, saw first-hand what Maria and her father were capable of.

Claire and Andrew Tavener were a sociable couple. But when Andrew drank, he became paranoid and possessive. So when he threatened to kill his 'cheating' wife, his friends wrote it off as the rambling of a drunk.

Dallas Augustine had a rocky start in life, including a famous mother cut down in her prime by a murderous husband. Then, when she met Jessie McCaskill, it seemed her life had fallen into place. But their marriage soon descended into violence.

To help the IMF team break up a crime syndicate that specializes in brainwashing ex-convicts into committing political assassinations, Barney substitutes for a former prisoner looking for an operation to give himself a new appearance.
Guest stars Gerald S. O'Loughlin and Christopher Stone portray crime syndicate bosses in charge of the waterfront who extort huge sums of money from every ship docking at a west coast port.

An undercover agent is murdered while trying to intercept a huge heroin shipment in the Pacific Northwest and the IMF team is called to take over and put the dealer and his chief executioner out of business.
Guest star Elizabeth Ashley plays the alcoholic wife of a crime syndicate leader whose involvement in an intimidation racket and the cold-blooded murder of an employee puts the IMF team on his trail.

Stolen gems worth seventy-five million dollars scheduled to be fenced to an underworld figure suddenly disappear and the ship on which they were being transported is blown up at sea bringing the IMF team into the picture.

Guest star Kevin McCarthy plays the role of a highly-placed Defense Department advisor who has murdered an Air Force official and sold vital top-secret material about America's nuclear defenses to foreign powers.

Barney poses as a prospective rock-music recording artist to get evidence linking an organized crime figurehead played by guest star William Windom to the sudden death of a beautiful recording star who was being blackmailed by the syndicate.

Guest star Steve Forrest plays the role of a millionaire publisher and communications tycoon who has sold fifty-one percent of his empire to an underworld crime syndicate which gives them a powerful influence over state politics.
Christopher George guest stars in the role of a psychotic ex-convict determined to wreak vengeance on society.

p.t: Mission: Impossible: Run for the Money
p.d: Guest stars Richard Jaeckel and Herbert Edelman play gangsters who try to get control of all the illegal betting parlors in the country as well as a virtual takeover of all thoroughbred horse racing.
Jim Phelps and his IMF team are given the assignment of breaking an underworld ring attempting to set up one of the world's largest drug manufacturing plants off the coast of Africa.
Casey poses as a young peasant girl from Europe imported to be the bride of Joe Corvin, the top man at getting underworld millions into Swiss banks.
Guest star Bradford Dillman plays Edison, a former private detective turned extortionist who is blackmailing a powerful crime chief with a roll of film linking him to murder.

Barney assumes the identity of a powerful psychic from a Caribbean island kingdom in order to hypnotize a defecting crime syndicate leader into revealing his super secret list of government officials on the take.
Nora Dawson, a witness to a murder, is committed to an asylum and is being systematically driven out of her mind with drugs when the IMF team is given twenty-four hours to save her life.

Tripitaka dreams of a slain king whose throne was stolen by a Taoist imposter. With the prince’s help, the pilgrims set out to reveal the false king and restore the rightful ruler.
A wall divides the lands of night and day. The Queen of Night feasts on blood, the King of Day enslaves all. Reuniting them is hard when Monkey and Pigsy are both distracted by women.

Codslow suffers under three immortal tyrants. The pilgrims aid a family against the rulers who draw power from pearls, paper, and wine. Pigsy nearly roasts before Monkey devises a plan to free the land.
Pigsy searches for a missing girl, finding she’s married to a slug monster. Disguised as the slug, he lives with vain Hai-Min—until she notices her husband isn’t so slimy after all.
In a volcanic land plagued by quakes, a catfish demon and a faceless shape-changer fight. A priest claims one pilgrim is the impostor. Distrust splits the group apart.
The pilgrims meet a man digging a mountain tunnel for 22 years. Tripitaka insists they help, but Monkey’s magic shortcut angers him. Banished Monkey leaves them vulnerable to grave danger.
The King of Unicorns seeks Monkey’s magic staff as a gift. Using a magic ring, he captures Tripitaka and weakens Monkey. Pigsy, tempted by Chun-Shou, must resist to save his master.
The Grey Gloves Devil kills villages with hypnotic eyes. While Pigsy lags, a woman mistakes Tripitaka for her lost son. Captured, Pigsy must escape before the Devil strikes again.
A village is ravaged by locusts led by Demon Queen Grasshopper, chasing the magic Lake Lok-Nor. Can the pilgrims stop her swarms, or will she turn them all into pigs?
Honored guests of a prime minister, the pilgrims face black magicians and bandits. Tripitaka falls ill with Tibetan Fever, while Pigsy hunts a vampire and uncovers a shocking truth.
In a blizzard, starving pilgrims hide in a cave. Monkey tricks Pigsy into “sacrifice,” making Tripitaka believe he ate his disciple. Overcome with grief, he is possessed by Pigsy’s spirit.
In the Red Hog kingdom, pigs are gods and Pigsy is crowned king. But the ruler is a demon who slew the old king. Rebels help Monkey and Sandy save the princess and stop the cult.
In a ghostly village, demons and witches await the pilgrims. If believed in, they live again. One by one, the travellers are lured into deadly traps of illusion and betrayal.
A God cursed two lovers, aging Yu-Lee into the Well’s keeper. To restore her youth, Tripitaka must drink. Chaos ensues when Pigsy and Sandy drink the water—becoming pregnant.
In the Fire Queen’s land, volcanoes block the way. Only her magic fan can douse the flames, but since her husband left her for a human, winning her aid proves a fiery challenge.
After finding the body of a young girl in a stream located in the suburbs of Montreal, investigators strive to retrace a murderer who knew how to use water to his advantage.

p.t: Dark Waters of Crime: Bad Trip
p.d: On August 20, 2001, Charles Tremblay, 15, was beaten, then thrown into the St-Charles River where he drowned. Tremblay's body was discovered in the mud less than 24 hours after his death.

p.t: Dark Waters of Crime: Mortal Passion
p.d: In early April 2000, two students discover the lifeless body of a young woman on the edge of a river. The victim has wounds on her neck, but a murder weapon is not found at the scene. Investigators find a piece of paper in the victim’s pant pocket.

The story of a young girl savagely beaten by a group of teenagers and later found dead in a river leads to a troubling inquiry whereby water causes several complications as well as the solution to the case.

p.t: The Case: A Killer on the Loose
p.d: Susanna Zetterberg, a 19-year-old Swedish girl abducted as she left a Parisian nightclub,
It isn't his first crime scene, yet six years later it will continue to haunt him.
In pursuit of the former members of the French Connection who were preparing a major coup between South America, Spain and the south of France.
After moving to a quiet suburb, Mary finds a new best friend in next-door neighbor Jane. But, before long, it's clear that there's something strange about Jane.

p.t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: Nightmare Next Door
p.d: 13-year-old Jessie Cooper thinks Nick Hamilton is just a nice neighbor. Little does she know he's a sex offender with a penchant for adolescent girls.
After meeting online, Patrick begins to stalk Kristen across the web. Kristen begins to realize that nothing will stop her cyberstalker from tracking her down with deadly intentions.

p.t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: The Ties that Blind
p.d: Kathy is thrilled when her husband David treats her well, as he often beats her down with insults and abuse. When Kathy tries to escape her marriage, David is not about to let her go.

p.t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: Campaign of Terror
p.d: Bob Krueger is devastated to lose a race for the Senate. But nothing could protect his family from the obsession of a former staffer who now threatens to destroy them.
Marie DePalma, a shy middle school student in Detroit, is thrilled when an older student takes an interest in her. As their relationship develops, her life turns into a living hell.

p.t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: Nowhere to Run
p.d: After three years of emotional abuse, Peggy breaks it off with her boyfriend. But when he begins watching Peggy's every move, she has to take matters into her own hands.

p.t: Stalked: Someone's Watching: Married To Madness
p.d: When Susan Zarriello's ex-husband David unleashes a sadistic torrent of cyber attacks 15 years after their divorce, Susan realizes he's been watching her for years.

The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of The Whole Truth, has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction…by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

An experiment at St. Peter's Hospital threatens the natural order of things when an embittered billionaire (William Hickey) pays a brilliant cardiologist (Bruce Davidson) to help him cheat death. But is death willing to be cheated so easily?

Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems too good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes a job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it…but nothing comes without a cost.

When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister is the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman…from under the bed.

Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead…or alive.

Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discovers what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

Jennifer (Marlee Matlin), deaf since birth, has had a revolutionary implant in her ear, to help her hear for the first time. The device doesn't help her to hear normal conversation and sounds, but she does hear...something…from The Outer Limits.
Whatever or whoever haunts The Four Crosses Inn is certainly making themselves known, and the Most Haunted team delve deeper into it’s legend with dramatic results.
The night at the Four Crosses Inn was relentless and although tired, the team continued their investigation which proved almost too much for one of them.

Yvette takes the team and boards the ghost ship TSS Duke of Lancaster. The abandoned rooms, corridors and decks are said to be home to a number of paranormal happenings. The team have one night to investigate.
With activity already putting the team on high alert, they split up and it isn’t long before the long dead come to life.
Realising the enormity of their task the Most Haunted team continue walking the dark derelict decks of the TSS Duke of Lancaster. But something seems to be following them.

Yvette Fielding takes her team to Blackpool and the haunted Regent Cinema where many a paranormal event has taken place. The team split up and it isn’t long before at least one of them regrets their decision.
The team continue their investigation into The Regent Cinema by splitting up once again and strange paranormal activity isn’t far behind.
A mill on the boarder of England and Wales with a history of death, Chirk Mill is said to have its fair share of ghosts. The team split up and soon find that something is their in the dark.
Yvette and her team continue their investigation into Chirk Mill, where one entity seems eager to play a tune.

p.t: Most Haunted: Royal Court Theatre - Bacup
p.d: The world famous ghost hunting team return for a new series and start in a smalltheatre with a big problem…ghosts.
The team are joined by five members of the English rugby team as they investigate an allbut forgotten piece of British history.
p 8: Drakelow Tunnels - Kidderminster: With over 4 miles of haunted tunnels the team have one night to investigate this labyrinth of horror.

p.t: Most Haunted: The National Emergency Services Gallery
p.d: A terrifying place full of history and paranormal activity. The team are tested as the tryto find the spirits that refuse to leave this famous location.

p.t: Most Haunted: The Galleries of Justice
p.d: The legendary ghost hunters continue in Nottingham and a place where people could be jailed, sentenced and executed without even leaving the building.
The first of a two-part investigation with celebrity guests, world famous band ‘Bullet for My Valentine’.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Margam Castle P1
p.d: Karl investigates the ground floor back rooms of this landmark castle alone, but soon realises that something is lurking in the shadows.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Margam Castle P2
p.d: The upper floors of Margam Castle are said to be haunted by many different spirits, Stuart goes it alone to try and find them.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Dorchester Prison 2 P1
p.d: Said to be the Most Haunted prison in the UK, HMP Dorchester is a scary place to be with a group of people but alone it becomes terrifying. Karl investigates the upper cells and gets more than he bargained for.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Dorchester Prison 2 P2
p.d: Stuart enters the underbelly of this remarkable building and starts to witness some very strange occurrences.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Armely Mills Cottage
p.d: The cottage on the site of Armley Mills is said to be full of paranormal activity so Karl decides to enter, alone and witnesses something that is eager to grab his attention.

Abandoned prisons are always a daunting prospect and the Most Haunted team love them. This time Karl takes on HMP Shrewsbury alone and experiences some of the unhappy phantoms that lurk in the shadows.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Samlesbury Hall P1
p.d: With a history dating back to 1185, Salmesbury Hall is of the UK’s most historic buildings and said to be one of the most haunted. With ghost stories and sightings all over the building, Stuart investigates the ground floor.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Samlesbury Hall P2
p.d: Karl investigates the upper floors of this historic building dating back to 1185, and realises he is not alone.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Gressenhall Workhouse Pt1
p.d: Karl investigates the very haunted school room in the large imposing Gressenhall Workhouse. The activity starts even before Karl gets into the building and becomes one of the most impressive investigations to date.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Gressenhall Workhouse Pt2
p.d: Stuart investigates two buildings, a forge and the cottage. He could not have imagined the activity that unfolded around him.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Bishton Hall P1
p.d: Stuart investigates the main house and seems to be pulled in different directions from an unexplained energy.

p.t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Bishton Hall P2
p.d: Karl ventures down into the cellars of this large country house and soon comes under attack from an unseen force.
Karl enters a Masonic Temple alone, seeking the truth behind its eerie reputation. The mysterious world of Freemasonry soon reveals a chilling presence in the shadows.
Cameras are left locked-off in haunted sites across the country, capturing chilling activity in a bold experiment with some truly remarkable results.
Karl enters the formidable HMP Gloucester and sets up an experiment with some amazing results.
During a heat wave, 15 Division opens to the public as a cooling station; Andy and Marlo search for a missing woman.
Andy considers leaving town for a four-month undercover project; Jarvis reveals the division will be restructured.
Andy is left stranded on the side of the road with a dying man and no way to get help on her wedding day.

p.t: Perfume: The Story of a Murderer
p.d: Young women in 18th-century France turn up dead while a noted perfumer (Ben Whishaw) obsessively carries out a quest to capture an elusive aroma.
During the era of Tammany Hall's sway, a young man (Leonardo DiCaprio) vows vengeance on the vicious gangster (Daniel Day-Lewis) who killed his father.

Emilia travels to the Yorkshire town of Rotherham to uncover the details of a horrific double murder separated by more than two decades. In April 2019 the body of Alena Grlakova was discovered by police after she had gone missing on Boxing Day.

In May 1996 the murder of Stephen Cameron hit newspaper headlines as one of the first examples in the UK of a road rage killing. Emilia visits the town of Swanley to uncover the details of this tragic case.

In April 2015, 24-year-old student Karen Buckley went missing while on a night out in Glasgow. Emilia visits the location where Karen was last seen, the Sanctuary nightclub, and learns about the investigation that tried to find her.

Emilia visits Peterborough, where a young woman, Sally Ann McGrath, went missing in 1979, having last been seen in the city centre. It took nearly eight months for her body to be found, after police assumed she had simply run away.

The quiet seaside town of Mablethorpe was an unlikely location for what appeared to be an organised hit on a couple in their 50s. Emilia travels to the Lincolnshire coast to learn about the violent murders of Joan and John Stirland in 2004.
Jordan Monaghan comes under suspicion when his girlfriend is found dead. After all, he is already linked to two other suspicious deaths. Is he a serial killer?
As the world continues to evolve into the digital age, people are capturing images in the sky that they are unable to explain.
What are UFOs? Are they spacecraft? Or vessels of a different kind, from a place beyond imagination? Do they travel vast distances to reach planet Earth? And do they come in peace-- or to conquer?
Take a fresh look at some classic alien encounters, UFOs and abductions, and discover several new stories.
Nazi UFOs: Could alien technology have helped the Nazis' rise to power? Experts question whether Hitler had extraterrestrial help in his quest for world domination.
Join us as we investigate the existence of UFOs and determine the possibility that they may be from Earth.
Previously sealed documents hint at compelling new theories about extraterrestrials. Could aliens be living among us? And could former US Presidents know something we don't?
Alien Achilles Heel. Many believe aliens are already here on Earth. Could they be plotting an attack? And if so, can humans survive their weapons' terrifying capabilities?
Experts open previously off-limits files in a bid to answer some of the most mysterious questions surrounding UFOs and extra-terrestrial life.

Nearly three hundred million people worldwide claim to have been abducted by aliens. Many report being subjected to torturous medical experiments. Others return with unwelcome reminders of their ordeal. Are aliens creating human hybrids?
Top Civilian Encounters: From mass sightings in the sky to reports of alien probes found in human bodies, explore the ten most disturbing extraterrestrial encounters ever.
This episode looks at whether fighter jets provide an adequate defense security against UFOs.
With science closer than ever to proving that life once lived on Mars, is there a chance that something still exists there?
UFO Metal: Nations all over the world are rumoured to have found metal debris from UFO crashes. Join the investigation into the alleged wreckages of otherworldly crafts.

In 2011, a vault of US government files about UFO sightings and alien activity was released. This series investigates these documents and re-examines key evidence about UFOs, alien abductions and government cover-ups.

p.t: Alien Files Unsealed: Aliens on the Moon
p.d: A look at the possibility that life began on Mars and travelled to Earth. Plus, if aliens exist, what plans do they have in store for us? Experts investigate.
Can man beat machine in a 30-foot, standing-start sprint? Can a driver lose 10lbs during a race? Can the suction created by a speeding car rip loose a manhole cover during a street race?
Myths tested: Can a jet pack be created from plans on the internet? Do pyramids have special powers?
Will opening all of the windows of a house during a hurricane lessen the structure's damage? Will a human head that has been dipped in liquid nitrogen for 5 seconds shatter when slammed into a table?
Can someone really be knocked out of their socks? Is the force exerted between two cars crashing into each other at 50mph the same as a single car hitting a wall at 50mph?
Myths tested: Is it possible to slingshot a person over the border and onto a mattress?
Can honey bees lift a laptop? Can hitting a bug at high speeds on a motorcycle be fatal? Can hanging a bag of water repel flies?
Myths tested: Can a person take to the skies using only a lawn chair and weather balloons? Can someone test positive for heroin by eating a large amount of poppy seeds?
Can you survive a 35-foot fall while covered in bubble wrap? Can a rocket-powered ejector seat flip an upside-down car back onto its wheels, as seen in Die Another Day?
This special episode pays homage to Buster the Crash Test Dummy. Without him, either dozens of myths would have gone untested or Jamie and Adam would constantly be at the local hospital.
Myths tested: Do birds flying in a trailer cause the trailer to become lighter? Will a boat crashing into a channel marker cleave itself in half?
Can a motorcycle traveling at highway speeds drive across the surface of a lake? Can you survive a jump from a high-rise building with a parachute made from a hotel room's contents?
Myths tested: Can a barrel of bricks from the top of a building hit a man multiple times? Can a person be electrocuted by urinating on the third rail?
It’s a shame that not all of the testing footage can be included in the final show that goes to air. In this special episode, the outtakes are in with never-before-seen footage.
Myths tested: Can a person be launched by rockets strapped to a chair, like in the Ming Dynasty tale? Can jumping into a ceiling fan cause a person to lose his head?
Myths tested: Can a scuba diver be sucked up in a firefighting helicopter? Are various car myths from movies true?

Ed adopts an abandoned bear cub; Chris manipulates his dreams; Maurice learns Cicely's population is declining.
Semanski becomes attached to violinist Cal Ingraham while escorting him to the mental institution; Phil's lack of etiquette offends Marilyn's mother.
Maurice reconsiders his plan to propose to Barbara; Chris tries to have a good time while Maggie visits an old flame.
Joel tries to adjust to his new surroundings while looking for a loophole in his contract with the state.
Maggie sees Joel in a new light when he donates inherited land to the Indians, then learns of his ulterior motive.
Holling leaves an expectant Shelly waiting at the altar; Joel convinces some Japanese investors to buy his way out of Cicely.
A flu epidemic in Cicely spoils Joel's romantic reunion with his visiting fiancée, Elaine, who is befriended by Maggie.
A shocked Holling learns that Shelly is married when her husband arrives in Cicely to ask for a divorce; Ed attempts to write a blockbuster movie.
When Maurice realizes he has no heir, he asks Chris to become his son; Maggie helps Joel teach childbirth classes.
Joel claims to have been rescued by a legendary Bigfoot-like creature; Chris becomes friends with an artist who turns out to be his brother.
The Cicely townspeople rally to help Joel cope when they learn that his New York fiancée has left him for an older man.
Maggie purports Joel to be her boyfriend to gain her father's approval; Holling comes to a very personal decision.
Joel reconsiders a visit to New York when his temporary replacement charms the townspeople and Maggie dreams his plane crashes.
Spring: Holling picks fights with patrons; Ed seeks a once-a-year kleptomaniac; Maurice falls for a trooper.

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Failed 5 Times?
p.d: Did Everett touch his girlfriend Michelle’s daughter? Her ex Robert says that his 7-year-old daughter said so. Everett will take a lie detector test to disprove it! Don’t miss these shocking results!

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen
p.d: Kelsey says her husband is abusing her. Malcolm believes that Kelsey has been cheating on him since the beginning and that their two kids may belong to another man. Plus, Carrie's boyfriend Chris thinks their child belongs to her ex.

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: This Should Be Explosive...
p.d: Katrina believes her sister Kendra’s boyfriend is a cheater and having sex with her best friend Nay-Nay! Later, John returns to the stage with a shocking update!

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I’m Starving Myself to Death
p.d: Pamela aims to weigh 40 pounds. Samantha, who suffers from bulimia and alcoholism, steals to accomplish her binging. Can both women confront their eating disorders with support and treatment?

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Mommy Hurt Me
p.d: Stephanie’s drug addiction led her to neglect and abuse her kids. Scott’s fiancée stepped up as a mother and Stephanie failed multiple drug tests, he doesn’t want her near the kids, but wants her to atone for her wrongs!

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: I’m Not the Man You Think I Am
p.d: Sean says his wife has made him so angry that he’s put her in the hospital over 10 times. Sean’s also got a secret of his own — he is really a she! Can Steve help Sean iron out his issues?

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?
p.d: Russell wants to put his family back together after his three children died in a fire. Next, Tatiana believes her 2-year-old nephew was abused. And she's accusing her sister's ex-fiancé Chris. Chris says he's not an abuser.

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: He Said Give Your Baby Away and You Did
p.d: Shannan claims Tim fathered her child. He doesn't buy it because he doesn't recall having sex with her! Later, Ayana is furious that her boyfriend Patrick denies their son!

When ordinary people need help, Steve Wilkos is ready to answer the call. Watch as Steve helps ordinary people stand up for themselves and fight for what he believes in order to promote justice for all.

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: What Happened to My Baby?
p.d: Baby Garrett died of an oxycodone drug overdose while in Sharon’s care. His mother Casey left him with Sharon so she could visit her husband Kenneth in the hospital. Who’s responsible?

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Better Not Fail That Test!
p.d: Lainie and Justin have a 9-month-old baby together. Justin hurts Lainie because he thinks she’s cheating. But how will Steve react when he confronts Justin?

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
p.d: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: She Said She'd Drown the Baby
p.d: Devon slipped into a coma and is on life support. But before he fell into a coma, he told his mother that his ex Alisha said he did not father their son. Alisha denies ever saying this and feels his whole family has turned their backs on her.

p.t: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Murder My Daughter?
p.d: Teenager Megan lives with her older controlling boyfriend Rick. Megan cannot attend school, find a job, or even eat without his OK! Can her aunt and Steve get through to her?

p.t: The Jerry Springer Show: One Night Stand Shockers
p.d: Bizarre sexual fetishes come out! Brad’s girlfriend wants him to dress like a little girl. Melissa wants her boyfriend Steve to stop his sexual fetish of flashing.

In Las Vegas, 41-year-old Nancy Menke, a mother of four, is found handcuffed and murdered in the passenger seat of her car; a records clerk in the insurance fraud unit stumbles upon a strange report that blows open Menke's murder case.

p.t: On the Case: In the Blink of an Eye
p.d: November 21, 1988, Sheriff's deputies received an alarming phone call from a convenience store in Leesville, Louisiana. A delivery person said the clerk who signs for deliveries was missing and the store's cash register was open and empty
When a teenager is found savagely stabbed to death in her home, police hope a trail of blood found at the crime scene will lead them to her killer.
A woman's walk home from a night out at a dance club ends in a brutal murder.

p.t: On the Case: Long Sought Truth
p.d: Sunday December 3rd, 1978. A motorist walked into the empty office of a Palmdale, California gas station and stumbled upon the aftermath of a violent robbery. Even more chilling was the fact that station's attendant was nowhere to be found.

p.t: On the Case: A Different Time
p.d: When Barbara Rowan left her house on an afternoon in 1984, she had a baseball mitt, a ball and a radio. Barbara claimed she was on her way to meet her coach. After she didn't return home, Police discovered that the teenager didn't play any sports.

p.t: On the Case: A Murder in Coralville
p.d: October 21st, 1981 22-year-old Vicki Klotzbach was reported missing. The research lab employee failed to show up for work and no one had seen or heard from Vicki in more than 24 hours

p.t: On the Case: A Killer in the Sun
p.d: When Kenny Baker returns home, the backdoor is ajar and his wife, Kathy, and two-year-old son, Ryan, are nowhere to be found.

p.t: On the Case: A Knock on the Door
p.d: A beautiful young mother is found murdered in the bedroom of her home. The only witness was her five year old son. Would he be able to help police solve the crime?

p.t: On the Case: Racing to Justice
p.d: A talented chef's abduction is the impetus for what will turn out to be a chilling homicide investigation.

p.t: On the Case: River of Sadness
p.d: A heartbreaking mystery begins with the discovery of a young woman's body floating in Washington state's Yakima River.

p.t: On the Case: A Murder in Pelham
p.d: A daughter spends 25 years pursuing the truth behind her mother's mysterious murder.

p.t: On the Case: An Uninvited Guest
p.d: A son discovers his mother's violent murder and police must track down the killer who committed a deadly betrayal.

When 15 Division goes undercover at a club-land bar that’s a possible hub for illegal handguns, Chris’s erratic behavior and concern for a specific drug dealer make Dov suspicious.
Kane knows The Ghost is now closer than ever…Kane and his team have removed The Ghost’s support systems but fall under attack when they try to secure the suitcase nukes.
The man who attacked a blind woman is found dead, supposedly shot by the woman's cheating husband.
It's Christmastime, but McCabe isn't feeling so jolly as an ambitious assistant DA helps Jake find a murderous Santa Claus.
Jake discovers a murder plot and takes the place of a dead hit man whose target happens to be McCabe.
When Jake discovers that a serial rapist's weakness is cats, a victim agrees to help set a trap.
Jake suspects that a newswoman knows more about a gangster's murder than she's letting on, so McCabe attempts to get the truth from an unwilling witness: the newswoman's daughter.
McCabe and Derek are held captive by a grenade-laden gunman claiming to be out for revenge, but Jake discovers a different motive.
McCabe believes that what looks like a drunken-driving accident is a murder, so he sends Jake to investigate.
After ten years on the run, a murder witness returns to use McCabe against a powerful defendant for a big payoff, and Jake must escort the witness to court in one piece.
Jake sets out to expose the double life of an alleged kidnapped heiress who's determined to get romantically close to him.
Jake tries to prove that his friend, a philandering priest, is innocent in the murder of his married lover.
An author who's a former cop literally kills for a best-seller, giving Jake and McCabe a plot that keeps them guessing.
An ambitious exec and his devious wife desperate for success commit a murder, and it's up to Jake and McCabe to put them out of business.
Detectives Lund and Strange travel to Afghanistan to continue their investigation. Thomas Buch calls a party meeting to challenge the Prime Minister.
Detectives Lund and Strange return from Afghanistan with new, incontrovertible evidence.
Everyone's plans are disrupted when body parts are found at Copenhagen dock only hours before a scheduled visit by the Prime Minister.

In 1995 Paris, Guy Georges, a serial killer, was linked to multiple murders through DNA and later confessed in court. He was sentenced to life in prison, leading to the establishment of a DNA database for offenders in France.

In February 1977, Australian heiress Janie Shepherd vanishes in London. David Lashley, a convicted rapist, later confesses to her murder in prison. In 1990, he is convicted based on this confession and sentenced to life.
This is the tragic tale of Susan Smith, who shocked the nation in 1994 by fabricating a carjacking to cover up the drowning murders of her two young sons.
In 1999, NFL player Rae Carruth is convicted for orchestrating the shooting of his pregnant girlfriend. He is sentenced to 18-24 years. Their son, Chancellor, has cerebral palsy.
In January 2002, Ashley Pond and Miranda Gaddis disappear in Portland. Neighbor Ward Weaver, a suspect with a violent history, is later found guilty of their murders and sentenced to life in prison.
The fairy tale match between Kim VanPelt and Sandy Ozment turns into a nightmare after Sandy is found fatally beaten. Authorities hunt for the killer who destroyed wedded bliss.
After Joe finally marries his modern-day princess Jennifer, she mysteriously disappears, leaving behind a devastating trail of lies, betrayal and deception.
Bill finds the family he's dreamed of when he meets single mum Rose. Soon after he vanishes without explanation, but did he get cold feet or was he a marked man?
A wave of deception comes crashing down on newlyweds and police search for the recent bride as they uncover lies and betrayal.
A gloomy gunman annihilates the future of Toni Cato and her soldier husband Anthony Riggs, as a devious trail of greed, deception and betrayal come to the forefront.
Software designer Bruce Cleland marries a young, vivacious woman, then a carjacking leaves Cleland dead and prompts police to uncover a story of sex, money and hidden agendas.

In 1983, Graeme Cunningham vanishes in Salt Lake City. Detective Don Bell discovers Arthur Bishop, who confesses to killing Graeme and four other boys. Bishop is found guilty in 1984 and executed in 1988.
In September 1987, Simon Dale is murdered. His ex-wife, Susan Wilberforce, is acquitted of the crime but later convicted of fraud and sentenced to seven years. The murder remains unsolved.

In 1990, Danny Rolling killed five students in Gainesville, Florida. He confessed to the crimes, pleaded guilty to avoid the death penalty, but was ultimately sentenced to death and executed 16 years later.

In 2006, Nina Sharanova vanished in Oakland. Her ex-husband, Hans Reiser, was convicted of her murder after their son’s testimony and leading police to her body. Reiser is now appealing the conviction.
Sci-fi meets hilarity in this zany spoof about space aliens who land on Earth and become glitzy megastars. Mel Smith and Griff Rhys Jones star.
During WW2, convicted bank robber Eddie Chapman becomes a triple agent working for both the British and the Germans.
A Jewish prince seeks his family and revenge against his childhood friend who wrongfully imprisoned him.
ELVIRA'S HAUNTED HILLS culls its outragousness from the classic Vincent Price/Roger Corman films of the early 60's along with a little Rocky Horror Picture Show and Fearless Vampire Killers.
A group of young, anti-establishment Gen-X employees fight to save their record store from being overtaken by a conglomerate retail record corporation.

In this silent-style comedy, General Futtock hosts a weekend at his country estate. Chaos erupts as the butler (Sir Michael Hordern) spies on guests, rum spills into the punch, and a lost Japanese tourist adds to the mayhem. Hilarity ensues.
A group of men go to a villa in the French countryside where they resolve to eat themselves to death.

p.t: A Saint, A Woman, A Devil
p.d: Sylvia, a seemingly saintly woman in a quiet suburb, hiding a shocking secret—a multiple promiscuous personality disorder. As her personas push limits, Sylvia’s world spirals in this racy, action-filled thriller, where desire meets danger.
The Namtut brothers run the most popular restaurant in town, but their meals contain the human byproducts of their attempts to resurrect the ancient goddess of blood and lust.
A brutal Italian cannibal exploitation film.
Stan must lie to his wife to go out with Ollie.
Vampire Count Orlok expresses interest in a new residence and real estate agent Hutter's wife.
This powerful, fact-based absurdity-of-war film stars Kirk Douglas as a commanding officer who defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.

Derek’s community service at the school takes a bad turn when he gets into an altercation with Chris.
Jen decides to go to the school dance solo - and winds up having one of the worst nights of her life.
Mark discovers Laurel is moving back to Toronto at the same time Jen enlists his help to stop Derek from taking off to Mexico.
Laurel and Mark disagree on the ending to her video while Craig and Shannon worry about their on-screen kiss.
Mark discovers a bottle of vodka hidden in the rec room; Erin finds out about Kevin’s date with Brenda and decides to put a stop to it.
Kat plans a weekend getaway with Kurt; Shannon breaks up with Craig; Kevin can’t figure out why Erin and Brenda are mad at him.
Laurel and Mark are blind-sided by the news that Laurel is leaving much sooner than expected; Gil and Kevin prepare to do battle over Erin.
Anika and Chris plot how to use Shannon’s poem against her; Jennifer and Shannon cope with the growing mystery of Anika’s campaign focus.
The Election moves into its final phase and the outcome surprises everyone; the school is buzzing when the author of the poem appears to be outed.
Laurel announces she’s staying in Edgemont; Jennifer discovers election ballots missing; Kevin confesses to a crush on Erin.
Mark and Laurel find an apartment; Anika tries to save her reputation; Chris’s attraction to Jennifer grows.
Gil creates a list of the “hottest” girls at A.C. McKinley and posts it on-line; Anika uses Bekka against Jennifer’s newspaper editorials.
Anika launches a personal attack on Jennifer – in which she goes too far; Laurel and Mark make up; Erin and Kevin become a couple.
Kat moves back home and tells Laurel to leave; Anika and Erin face suspension; Jen and Chris enter the same contest.
Laurel’s plans for a romantic dinner with Mark go awry; Shannon mistakenly reveals her secret; Derek returns from jail; full-scale war erupts between Anika and Erin.

Thomas Doubting stumbles upon a magical amulet which takes him on a mysterious journey to the island of Sinmouth. The locals believe he is 'Mumbo Jumbo' – an entity who will restore their fortunes and rescue the beautiful Princess Vanilla.

Ray’s been asked to chaperone a school trip with his daughter Sally’s class. When characters from Ray’s criminal past believe he stole the loot from a bank they robbed, Ray will do whatever it takes to keep his daughter and her class out of harms way.

A raven-haired enchantress, Cassie Nightingale, mysteriously moves into the local haunted mansion, 'Grey House', and seems to change her neighbors lives using a hint of magic causing many to think she’s a witch.

An American inherits an old village church in England, where treasure is buried. Greedy Mr. Slee scents his opportunity to snatch the treasure. Diggity, a little cherub trying to earn his wings, helps uncover the treasure for the benefit of the village.

A recently widowed woman hires a Norwegian soccer player as an au pair to help her with her sons. When he moves to the small town, the family finds that a soccer ball can change sadness into laughter.
When the galaxy comes under the threat of a nefarious space captain, a mechanic and his newfound robot ally join an elite squad of combatants to save the universe.
A small family finds hope in their extraordinary son named Sailboat when a personal gesture awakens a global desire.

Two school kids strike up a friendship with an orphaned puppy named Benji. When danger befalls them and they end up kidnapped by robbers who are in over their heads, Benji and his scruffy sidekick come to the rescue.

The extraordinary true story of the black bear who would become the inspiration for the stories of A.A. Milne, and the heroic man who saved her life. Starring: Michael Fassbender, Gil Bellows, David Suchet
After receiving a bizarre series of encrypted messages, a group of kids embark on an adventure with an alien who needs their help.
Classic story of a little Swiss girl, who after the death of her parents is sent to live with her goat herding grandfather (Max Von Sydow) in the high Alpine mountains.
In 1965, 13 y.o. paperboy Andy's paired up with a geek on a project in the popular junior high teacher's class. Andy learns and grows from it.
12-year-old Pelle is bitten by an ant and develops superpowers. Aided by comic book nerd Wilhelm, Pelle creates a secret identity as superhero Antboy.
