The discovery of a Lost City leads Will and Holly into a dangerous confrontation with a Sleestak.
The Marshall family meets a bearded, ragged Civil War-era Confederate soldier mining for crystals in a bejeweled cavern.

Will and Holly experiment with the colorful crystal matrix table inside the pylon, causing apocalyptic weather conditions. The Marshalls must quickly learn to turn the atmosphere back to normal before the extreme weather destroys the Land of the Lost.
The Marshalls meet Enik, an intelligent talking Sleestak from another time who is also trying to find his way out of the Land of the Lost.
Will and Holly are saved from an attack by Grumpy and Big Alice through the combined efforts of Rick and the Pakuni.
Will passes up an opportunity to return home, refusing to leave his injured father and Holly behind.
Cha-Ka curiously follows Will and Holly to their cave, but after smelling Rick’s good cooking, Holly’s new perfume decides to stay permanently.
Will, Holly, and Rick Marshall fall under a hypnotic spell generated by the devious Sleestak.
Finn joins the explorers at the Treehouse. A team of archeologists suffer disease, violence, and distrust after opening an ancient urn that may have housed a demonic spirit.
The explorers seek out a portal, but are overtaken by a force that replaces Marguerite, Roxton, and Challenger with three demons. With an age of chaos impending, Finn must bring back her friends.
Challenger tests his nutritional elixir, but the drink causes hallucinations of his wife and younger self to appear in the treehouse. The others must find a cure before his visions become deadly.
Challenger is taken captive by a WWI transport pilot guarding a crashed plane full of stolen iridium ingots. He, Roxton, and Marguerite relive their deepest secrets, each connected to the cargo.
An old enemy returns with a powerful artifact that could give him total power over the plateau. Veronica believes that her mother's pendant is leading her back to her parents.
Allan comes to Sydney, telling he has 12 hours before a Necron virus kills him unless he delivers Tau to a blackmailer who has the antidote.
Quan Shu, Manchuria 1359 BC: The Chinese invent an explosive gift egg. New York, 2001: A rival beats Sydney and Nigel to a map leading to the Dragon's Egg.
A country of only six million people where a vast percentage of the land is steaming hot jungle or a huge scrub desert known simply as The Chaco. This is one of the least known nations in the world.
After eight years, Tony returns to South Korea. And this time, he’s no stranger to kimchi. But just as Tony has changed, so has Korea.
Libyan hip-hop, Italian restaurants, tribal allegiances and post-war uncertainty in Libya. Bourdain looks at the country through personal stories, food, and the music of anti-Qaddafi rapper expats.
This unique episode looks closely at the “other” Massachusetts far away from the blue blood getaways of Nantucket or the urban sprawl of Boston that most people know so little about.
Ainsley's Caribbean adventure continues on Grenada, known as the Spice Island.
Tony and his friend, world-renowned chef Eric Ripert, explore the far reaches of indigenous Andes in search of a rare variety of wild cocoa that is said to be the best in the world.

Sicily isn’t about fast food or the fast life. It’s about savoring family, life, food and making the most of what you have. Tony will go in search of those foods and their producers and eat his way around the island.
Tony accompanies world-renowned chef and restaurateur Daniel Boulud as they travel back to Daniel’s hometown of Lyon, France for a pilgrimage of the city’s rich food culture and its legendary chefs.

In this episode of Parts Unknown Tony travels back to his homeland, his roots, his favorite state in the union: New Jersey. Part nostalgia, part cautionary tale. Tony makes sure to hit up some NJ classics.
Tony explores what Burroughs called Interzone, where artists sought escape from Western moral prohibitions and the possibilities of great empty spaces. But what is it like now?

Once Johannesburg was the most dangerous city in the world, but the end of the apartheid has lead to vast changes in the city. Tony visits the Johannesburg suburb of Hillbrow, and discovers the culture and, of course food.
Ainsley's Caribbean Kitchen travels to Dominica where the wild rainforests hide many waterfalls and rivers.
Few countries have a more contentious relationship with the United States than Iran. In this episode we heads to this Shia Muslim nation to explore a country few Americans have visited since the 80s.

Tony travels to Las Vegas Nevada with his food author friend Michael Ruhlman. Whatever your need, whatever bad behaviour you’d like to display Las Vegas is the place that will allow it... for a price.
The penultimate episode of Ainsley's Caribbean Kitchen sees the chef travel to Antigua to experience the island.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the Imperial War Museum, London
p.d: From Churchill risking his life in the Blitz to 21st Century soldiers who become invisible, discover the secrets inside the Imperial War Museum.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the Topkapi Palace Museum, Istanbul
p.d: From assassins who plot to poison a Sultan to bitter enemies who sign the world’s first peace treaty, discover the secrets inside the Topkapi Palace Museum.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the Egyptian Museum
p.d: From the mystery of a Pharaoh’s gold to the strange practice of animal mummification, discover the secrets inside the Egyptian Museum.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the Chateau of Versailles, Paris
p.d: From the schemes of Marie Antoinette to the spectrum of a star that reveals the origin of human life, discover the secrets inside the Chateau of Versailles.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the Bardo Museum, Tunisia
p.d: From the real lives of gladiators to the connection between Star Wars and Tunisia, discover the secrets inside the Bardo Museum.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienna
p.d: From the alchemy of turning silver into gold to a dance craze that changed history, discover the secrets inside the Kunsthistorisches Museum.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the Uffizi Gallery, Florence
p.d: From a famous artist who vanished to a traitorous Nazi who saved the day, discover the secrets inside the Uffizi Gallery.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the Metropolitan Museum, New York
p.d: From the mystery of a king’s madness to a silver chalice some think is the Holy Grail, discover the secrets inside the Metropolitan Museum.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the National Archeological Museum of Athens
p.d: From a dodgy archeologist who discovers a golden mask to an ancient gadget that reveals the future, discover the secrets inside the National Archaeological Museum.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the National Museum of Anthropology, Mexico City
p.d: From ancient athletes who kick a severed head to a peasant dress that brings down an empire, discover the secrets inside the National Museum of Anthropology.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the Smithsonian Institution, Washington DC
p.d: From the Zeros that bombed Pearl Harbor to the rocket that could take humans to Mars, discover the secrets inside the Smithsonian Institution.
From Michelangelo’s Sistine Chapel frescoes to the fall of the Knights Templar, discover the secrets inside the Vatican Museums.

p.t: Museum Secrets: Inside the American Museum of Natural History, New York
p.d: From a dinosaur embryo that solves a murder mystery to a spacecraft catching a comet’s tail, discover the secrets inside the American Museum of Natural History.

p.t: Murder Maps: The Brides In The Bath Killer
p.d: George Smith had many aliases. He needed them for his many wives who he would soon murder in order to claim the inheritance. Catching this chameleon would be a gargantuan challenge.

p.t: Murder Maps: In The Shadow Of Jack
p.d: At the time of Jack The Ripper, London was home to some of the most terrible individuals the city has ever seen. One of the very worst was the elusive Borough Poisoner, George Chapman.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: Hot Money
p.d: After a bank robbery, the suspect, never out of sight, goes to his office where he locks himself in. But when the police search, there is no money!

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Missing Link
p.d: A skull, known as the Damascus man, is stolen from a museum and Colonel March's life is imperiled trying to solve the case.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Case of the Misguided Missal
p.d: A 15th century prayer volume disappears from a sealed casket inside a locked safe belonging to an Oxford Don; the supernatural is suspected.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Deadly Gift
p.d: A barmaid receives a gift, a music box from a thief, dead ten years. But someone is soon murdered and Colonel March believes the music holds the key.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Case of the Lively Ghost
p.d: A phony spiritualist believes she's truly summoned a real ghost. Colonel March attends her séance to discover the identity of the spirit's killer.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: Death in the Dressing Room
p.d: Murder and blackmail culminate when a call for help during a Javenese dance is the clue that Colonel March needs to prove a faulty alibi.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The New Invisible Man
p.d: Colonel March receives a queer complaint: a pair of disembodied gloves killed a manand there is no corpse, no blood, and no evidence of wrongdoing,

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: Passage At Arms
p.d: A woman is found dead, but was it suicide or murder? A French fencing match provides the telling clue.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Sorcerer
p.d: A psychologist is stabbed to death in a seemingly sealed room. Inspector March must find who killed him and how did they accomplish the task.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: Present Tense
p.d: Colonel March's niece, a believer in spiritualism, hears her dead husband's voice and becomes convinced he has returned as a ghost; but has he?

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: At Night All Cats Are Gray
p.d: A lady claims an odd man is following her and fears for her life. She’s later found murdered...in mismatched color, a telling clue for the inspector.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Case of the Kidnapped Poodle
p.d: Colonel March investigates a valuable stolen diamond as well as the kidnapping of a little boy's poodle; he thinks both incidents may be connected.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Invisible Knife
p.d: March must solve the mystery of how a man could be stabbed to death by an invisible knife, while attempting to summon The Devil during a black rite.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Strange Event at Roman Fall
p.d: A wife reports her husband, a reclusive mystery writer, has fallen off a cliff. Suspicion points to her as the killer and Colonel March investigates.

p.t: Colonel March of Scotland Yard: The Headless Hat
p.d: While on holiday in France, there is a murder at the docks and Colonel March is asked by a friend of the French police to assist.
A wealthy Asian girl is kidnapped in Vancouver. When the kidnappers make the fateful error of using the young girl’s cell phone, police are able to track their movements and capture the assailants.
A single mother in Saskatchewan visits a hospital in the midst of a panic attack. Her doctor sedates her. Then, she is certain, he rapes her.

In a Toronto suburb during the summer of 1996, a man leaves home for a business trip. He doesn’t return. Fearing foul play, his desperate wife finally reports her husband’s disappearance to the police.
A young couple hits the road, hitchhiking across North America. Free spirits keen to explore the world. When the young woman stops phoning home, her father is alarmed.
A small town public school teacher fails to arrive for work for the first time in thirty years, leaving an empty house and a baffled community.

In 1996 a serial bomber begins planting bombs in public places and terrorizes the Prince Edward Island community. The mystery person leaves a strange swastika as a calling card, eluding capture for eight years.

p.t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
p.d: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.

p.t: Crime Scene Solvers: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
p.d: On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed.

p.t: Crime Scene Solvers: Sylvie Darcy Case
p.d: On February 26th 2012, in the Yevelines. Around 11PM policemen are called for an assault in a parking lot in the forest of Saint-Lambet-des-Bois.

p.t: Crime Scene Solvers: Four Lovers For One Crime: The Joël Deprez Affair
p.d: On February 5, 2000, two hunters discover a charred body on the banks of the Oise.

p.t: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Hanging - Chantal Ternik Case
p.d: On April 3th 2003, Chantal Ternik, a 48 year old housewife, is discovered hanged in her house of Sanary-sur-Mer, in Var.

p.t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Jean-Raymond Blatti Case
p.d: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written DIRTY RAPIST.

p.t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
p.d: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

p.t: Crime Scene Solvers: The Little Martyrship of A10: The Inass Touloub Affair
p.d: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.

p.t: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
p.d: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.
Paul Martin is acquitted by a jury of the murder of his wife, although most people believe he did in fact kill her. To escape questioning reporters, he takes a house in the country.

Two jockeys who are good friends have a falling out when one accuses the other of foul practice during a race. Some years later, the accused jockey believes his accuser has obtained his revenge by supernatural means.
On a trip through India, a married couple encounters a beggar who seems to be different from all the others they've seen--the husband is convinced that this particular beggar is trying to kill them.
A man with a rare blood type is unwilling to donate his blood in order to save a girl's life, knowing that if he does he will be tormented by supernatural visions of her future.

p.t: One Step Beyond: Ordeal on Locust Street
p.d: A seemingly normal family is hiding a terrible secret: their son has the features of a deformed, fish-like monster.
Aboard a United States ship in Japanese waters during World War II, Captain Fielding is critically injured.
A poor, pretty, village woman living in Scotland in the 17th Century is sentenced to be burned at the stake, for the natural death of her lover, the son of an Earl

p.t: One Step Beyond: Night of the Kill
p.d: After being missing from home young Davey Morris tells his parents he was with a friendly Bigfoot type creature. Nobody believes him until they see giant footprints and evidence that the animal has been eating their food.

In a seedy bar washed up drunk Michael Barry tells the presenter how an elderly countess to whom he was a gigolo died wearing a beautiful necklace, as did her dowdy companion who inherited the jewelry.

p.t: One Step Beyond: The Open Window
p.d: Artist Anthony March has a premonition of his neighbor's untimely death.

p.t: One Step Beyond: A Message from Clara
p.d: A student taking night classes falls in love with his beautiful teacher. However, he begins to suspect that his dead ex-girlfriend may be using the teacher to try to communicate with him.
Two men who don't know each other find that their lives are intertwined by a strange psychic connection that may end up in the deaths of both.
Karloffs parchment-skin role set the standard for mummy movies, but many others have gotten wrapped up in their work over the years, as youll see.
The walking dead have been a mainstay of horror films for decades and Hollywood has made sure audiences will fear zombies anywhere and everywhere.
Many horror legends along with Karloff and Lugosi have taken their turn playing sinister scientists and frightful physicians.
In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury consultant will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

As a pair of schoolboys sneak a look around an empty private aircraft, two criminals take off with the kids still inside. Upon discovering the men are dangerous gangsters, the horrified lads inadvertently become embroiled in the mobsters's scheme.
In order to protect a woman from a robber, a male FBI agent disguises himself as an elderly woman.
A father (Dwayne Johnson) goes undercover for the DEA in order to free his son who was imprisoned after being set up in a drug deal.
Superhumans defy a government plot to harness and abuse their powers. Chris Evans and Dakota Fanning (the TWILIGHT films) team in a pulse-pounding paranormal thriller.
In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury consultant will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

p.t: Once Upon A Time In America
p.d: Sergio Leone's final film is the epic tale of the life of a Jewish gangster in New York.
Two veteran New York City detectives (Academy-Award-winners Robert De Niro and Al Pacino) hunt a vigilante who may be one of their own.
Notorious assassin Elektra unwittingly takes part in her former teacher's test when she protects a former target and his daughter from The Hand, a sinister crime syndicate of martial arts fighters.
A group of young, anti-establishment Gen-X employees fight to save their record store from being overtaken by a conglomerate retail record corporation.
Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried co-star in this sci-fi thriller set in a future world where aging stops at 25, and the only way for one man to stay alive is to steal more time.

Music icon Paula Abdul brings psychic medium Kim Russo back to her former California home where she was troubled by incessant spirits.
TV personality and The Real Housewives of Atlanta star NeNe Leakes joins psychic medium Kim Russo to investigate paranormal events connected to a wedding she attended in Atlanta, GA.
Along with his wife Tammy, football and broadcasting legend Terry Bradshaw calls upon psychic medium Kim Russo to gain clarity on the paranormal activity occurring on their Oklahoma ranch.
Psychic medium Kim Russo meets with rapper and actor Ice-T and his wife Coco as they explore a New Jersey factory and experience unexplainable events linked to the factory's deadly past.
Kelly Osbourne enlists psychic medium Kim Russo to help her solve a series of paranormal mysteries she experienced at a notoriously haunted Hollywood hotel.
Beverley Mitchell uncovers the evil past of an abandoned insane asylum; Mark Curry awakens an angry spirit in his new home; Donovan Leitch unearths an uninvited guest.
Linda and her sister discover an old rundown house in the woods with a murderous history; Carlos Mencia is nearly shot and killed when a spirit from his past comes to his rescue.
Erin and her husband are terrorized by restless spirits after they stumble upon an old mineshaft on their new property.
After losing her new boyfriend, Tracy seeks solitude in the dark arts and strikes a deal with the devil; Fairuza is attacked and nearly killed in her art studio.
Erik Estrada is visited by an apparition who comes to his rescue just in the nick of time. Micah Sloat and his sister encounter horrifying paranormal activity in their own home.
Scott Patterson encounters ghosts on death row; Maria Conchita Alonso is haunted by the tragic death of her best friend; and Christopher Atkins discovers a horrifying secret from a past life.
Pam visits her family's farm with her grandfather and is given an important message from one of her deceased ancestors.
Jermaine Jackson encounters the spirit of an elderly woman haunting his family's estate; a desperate spirit contacts Diane Ladd and pleads for help.
Looking for the perfect sanctuary to finish her book, Mindy Cohn is confronted with anything but solitude at a famous Pasadena apartment building; while at a crossroads.
A woman receives terrifying phone messages from an unknown caller who seems to be watching her every move. A baby goes missing after a couple brings an antique rocking chair into their home.
Jonny Smith is in Sweden testing the brand new Volvo S60 Polestar super saloon against its racing car cousin – the competition car of double Swedish Touring Car Champion Fredrick Ekblom.

Vicki Butler-Henderson enters the brutal world of professional truck racing. She drives a 1100bhp truck herself, before heading to the Nurburgring where she joins the pit crew of former champion, German Jochen Hahn.

Jason Plato and Tiff Needell are joined by Ayrton Senna's nephew, Bruno Senna, to conduct their fastest ever track test. They hold a thrilling race between the brand new Porsche 911 Turbo S and two supercar rivals from Noble and Nissan.

Vicki Butler-Henderson heads to the German HQ of the Dakar rally winning Mini X-Raid team, to experience the three toughest jobs in motorsport. She'll learn how to be a navigator, mechanic and driver before taking on Dakar rally legend Nani Roma

Jonny Smith goes behind-the-scenes at America's biggest motor race, the Indy 500. He hears what makes the event so special from triple winner Dario Franchitti, reveals the technical differences between F1 cars and Indy cars
Tiff Needell and Jason Plato hold a track battle between two executive cars with over 1000bhp between them. The brand new Audi RS6 and Mercedes E63 AMG are both designed to demolish autobahns
Vicki Butler-Henderson learns the skills needed to drive in the Special Forces, from former Royal Marine sniper Aldo Kane.
Tiff Needell heads to Le Mans, to race in the European version of legendary American race series NASCAR – the world's most popular motorsport.
Jonny Smith is in France, experiencing the action packed world of Rallycross; a cross between rallying and circuit racing, where 650bhp machines battle door to door.
Jason Plato and Tiff Needell pit three petrolhead icons against brand new, mainstream cars to find out if the classics we lust after are now outclassed by modern machines.

In this special rally themed show, Jason Plato and Tiff Needell swap race track for rally stage as they learn to master the art of rally driving. They're taught advanced driving skills by triple British Rally Champion Mark Higgins
In the opening show of the new series Jason Plato and Tiff Needell put two tyre shredding saloons against one another other on the track - the Mercedes AMG C63 S and Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio.

Fifth Gear presenter Jonny Smith is granted access-all-areas to Kia's top secret test facility in the Californian desert where he investigates the lengths manufacturers go to in the quest for ever greater reliability.
Danny has big retro plans for a 1972 Cutlass he hopes to flip, and is counting on his fab team to do her right.
Mike buys a Smart car and wants to trick it out at the shop, but Kevin warns that Danny hates new cars and can't find out about it until it's done.
Alice tackles Beverley's backside blunder. Jay wipes Bailey's holiday Poomoji tatt clean.
Jay banishes Ant's backside buddy, and Alice helps Chelsea get over the shock of her life.
Jay tackles Mark's Greek tragedy, while Alice helps Lois to celebrate her penguin persona.

Tattoo Fixers on Holidays is back and this week new arrival Glen banishes bad boy Ashley's Magaluf moto, Sketch helps Bobby get rid of his rank rabbit, Alice gives Rachel a sentimental design, and Jay strips Clair of an awful ex tat.
Jay is taking on best mates Sam and Laura's cheeky stickmen, Sketch is helping out Aaron with a lads holiday regret and spontaneous Danny's Magaluf mistake is Wrecked'tified.

Sketch takes on Bex whose stinker of a tat has left her feeling unloved, Alice helps Nikki with a tat that has mistakenly mugged off her husband and Glen creates an elegant design for Emma who has overcome a brave battle with Anorexia.

The pop up parlour in the sun gets a visit from a noughties heartthrob. Glen transforms Dave's shoddy shot glass. Sketch gives Zoe a bespoke design, Alice helps Jodie get rid of a bad decision and Glen rids Max of his unusual love.
Sketch hides a Kardashian catastrophe, Alice gives Lana's emoji a facelift, and Jay is moved by a family's story of bravery.

The Fixers are putting bad tatts to bed in the sunny Med. Jay is taking on Tom the Titty Whacker, Alice helps out Catherine a Cher impersonator with a awful orchid and Sketch destroys a Alex's bad boxing tat.

The pop up parlour takes on Caroline's Magaluf mistake, Maisie's ex best mate tat and Keiron's ex-rated rap lyrics. Also keen for some covers are horror loving couple Dan and Kelly, party girl Alice and naughtily nicknamed Nom.
The Fixers holiday hijinks continue, and this week Glen rids Mandy of her rabbits, Jay pulls off the perfect portrait and Alice gets her teeth into Helen's cupcake.

Jay conjures up an Amy Winehouse masterpiece, Alice crafts an amazing geometric wolf and sketch creates matching tattoos for Amy and Chantelle. Also looking for tattoo therapy is Wonky-eyed Shannon, gambling man James and Tat mad Dan.
Ramona shares her wedding plans, but Karen continues to offer unwelcome advice. Plus, Drita throws a 1980s-theme bash, where Love faces Carla, leading to a battle royale.
Dr. Drew discusses the brawl between Carla and Love; Ramona and Karen reveal the reasons they dislike Carla.
Drita joins Ang and Renee in Philadelphia for a 1920's inspired costume party, thrown by Alicia DiMichelle Garofalo, the wife of alleged wise guy, Eddie 'Tall Guy' Garofalo.

p.t: Count Duckula: Dr. Von Goosewing's Invisible Ray
p.d: Dr Von Goosewing, along with his new invisible ray, invades the castle in another attempt to kill Duckula

'Icy Pink': The Panther travels to Alaska to help an entrepreneurial Eskimo open up an ice cream factory. 'The End of Superpink': Super Pink has to prove to a little boy and his cat that it's brains, not brawn that determine a real superhero.

p.t: Count Duckula: The Rest is History
p.d: Duckula travels back in time to stop the first Count Duckula from becoming a vampire.
Dr Quackbrain lures Duckula to his dream machine for his greatest experiment.
Gaston and Pierre and Von Goosewing break into Castle Duckula to steal two vases.

Greenback kidnaps Penfold to get Danger Mouse to bring him four ingredients needed for an evil spell to take over the world: The hair of a yeti, straw from a witch's broom, a piece of the London fog monster, and the tail feathers of Count Duckula.
Duckula gets tricked by a fake Genie into going to India.

'The Inspector's Most Wanted': A criminal from The Inspector's past seeks revenge by having him perform on the all-too-realistic Cop Patrol television show. 'Pinky Appleseed,' Pinky's efforts to re-plant a forest are obstructed by Paul Bunyan.

p.t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: The Bird! The Bird!
p.d: While venturing in a snowy world, Toad is kidnapped by a nearsighted Birdo who is convinced that he is her missing baby.
Thinking he is rebuliding the castle, Duckula accidentally sells it to The Crow Brothers in disguise, brick by brick!
Transylvanian Television arrive at the castle to feature it in a television programme.
Danger Mouse must recover plans to a top secret device capable of shattering the world.

The Earth is flooded with instant custard. Danger Mouse and Penfold travel to outer space to find the Custard Mite of Glut, a small creature that can eat up the custard, but the planet that houses the Mite is controlled by armoured aliens.
A letter arrives at Castle Duckula sent by lawyers in London.

p.t: Super Mario Brothers Super Show: Mario Meets Koop-Zilla
p.d: In the oriental city of Sayonara, Mario, Toad, Princess Toadstool and Luigi, who is pulling the cart Mario, Toad and Princess Toadstool are riding, are searching for a weapon that can help them defeat King Koopa, Super Sushi.
Marcus finds an obscure Divinity Cluster scientist who may hold a key to new ways of altering our relationship with space-time. He succeeds all too well.

The Trans-Utopian's crew is trapped in separate folds of space-time with a ticking-clock to rejoin into one spacetime. Travis will meet Dante while Percy and Dante up a risky plan to extricate themselves from their respective hyperspatial traps.
Bounty Hunter Dante Montana encounters a dangerous old frenemy, while his partner, Luc, tracks a man who may hold the key to the Divinity Cluster, human genes with extraterrestrial origins.
Dante's still impressionable teenage niece, Percy, comes under the sway of a young, handsome psychopath. Her actions inadvertently threaten the life of her uncle.
When a ship of religious cultists commit mass suicide by diving their ship into the sun, the crew rescues a shuttle full of survivors, including the cult leader himself, Brother Thirteen.
After the crew capture a murderous psychopath named Petrakis, they cross paths with a Major Bartlett, who has a prisoner of his own to move... and military authorization to commandeer the Tulip.

p.t: Starhunter Redux: The Man Who Sold The World (REDUX)
p.d: When Dante and Luc leave the ship to track down a ruthless war criminal, Percy discovers an invasion of the Tulip by a deadly AI.
Dante brings a captive fugitive aboard, along with her teenage son, Ajit. Percy and Ajit's immediate attraction sparks a conflict which endangers everyone.
Dante must decide whether to save a scientist and his son from the clutches of the Raiders, or use them as a bargaining chip to find his own child.
Dante's crew capture an alleged murderer, wanted by The Orchard, who turns out to be Luc's ex-husband. Luc is left with only terrible options.
When Dante and Luc capture a Raider, Dante is caught between his sense of justice and his desire for vengeance.
When Dante loses Percy to corrupt Oberon police, he must work out a dangerous deal to free Percy, while she fights for her life in prison.
A cryogenic chamber in an abandoned section of the Tulip is accidentally powered up, and the legendary Colonel Bramwell emerges from a 50-year sleep.
Soon after Dante reconnects with an old friend, he appears to be killed in an accident.

p.t: New Twilight Zone: Teacher's Aide/Paladin of the Lost Hour
p.d: A teacher on a violent and gang-infested high school has trouble controlling her students/A Vietnam vet named Billy saves an old man named Gaspar from a mugging at a cemetery.

The evil sorcerer Mordred and his dark forces are pitted against the mythical sorcery of Merlin. Under Merlin's spell, Mordred and his mother have been imprisoned for 1500 years, but a meddlesome scientist from the present creates a gateway to escape.

Aliens attack Earth, using deadly electrical tornadoes as weapons. A farmer, his brilliant high school daughter, and a tornado blogger race against the clock to find a way to thwart the horrific invasion.
In the far reaches of space, a small crew, 20 years into their solitary mission, find things beginning to go hilariously wrong.

When aliens have infiltrated society by inhabiting bodies of select human beings, they plan a full-scale invasion of Earth. A detective finds the information that can stop the attack; however the information is in the mind of a six-year-old child.
Five young people find themselves stranded in Moscow, fighting to survive in the wake of a devastating alien attack.
Two countries race to have the first successful landing on Mars.

The human race is thrown into chaos when an alien invasion takes place. But the aliens have arrived for a very specific reason - to find the one boy out of 7 billion people who holds the power to destroy them.
16-year old Vivien is trapped in The Vestalis Academy, a prison-like boarding school. Reunited with Sophia who previously betrayed her, they embark on the horrifying truth behind their imprisonment.

Two crew members of a spaceship wake up from hypersleep to discover that all their colleagues are missing. Despite this, it appears that they are not alone. Starring: Dennis Quaid, Ben Foster, Cam Gigandet

A deserted ship arrives in New York City carrying its slaughtered crew and a horrific cargo: Mutant green eggs the size of footballs that pulsate with life until they spray hideous chest-bursting death.
The wife of a CIA agent seeks the truth, after she discovers that her husband’s accident was part of an inside job.

p.t: The Shape of Things to Come
p.d: Sometime in the future, man has set up colonies on the Moon, when Earth becomes uninhabitable. A madman decides to destroy the Moon colonies with his robots and automated ships, and only three people and their robot can stop him.
Prepare for an adventure that's out of this world! When an intelligent, lovable robot, known as F.R.E.D.I., goes missing from a secret government research facility it's found by 15 year old James.

NOVA scienceNOW tackles the big question: can we live forever? Hosted by astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson, examine these topics: Can My Car Live Forever?; Body Shop - Body Parts; Can We Slow Aging?; and Hibernation.

p.t: scienceNOW: Can We Make it to Mars?
p.d: NOVA scienceNOW reports from the frontiers of science. This program examines Space Dangers; Space Suits; Space Food; Plasma Rockets; and a profile of space roboticist and JPL engineer Vandi Verma.

p.t: scienceNOW: Where Did We Come From?
p.d: Hosted by Neil deGrasse Tyson, examine these topics: Revealing the Origins of Life; Origins of the Solar System; Lice and Human Evolution; and a profile of neuroscientist Andre Fenton who studies how brains store and experience memories.

p.t: scienceNOW: How Does the Brain Work?
p.d: Hosted by Neil deGrasse Tyson, examine these topics: Magic and the Brains; Can a Machine Think Like Us?; Magnetic Mind Control; and a profile of neuroscientist David Eagleman, who studies time perception and synesthesia.

p.t: scienceNOW: What Will the Future Be Like?
p.d: The technologies that will transform our lives decades from now are already taking shape in laboratories around the world. Segments include: Humanoid Robots; Mind-Reading Machines; Augmented Reality; Profile - Adrien Treuille.

Hosted by Neil deGrasse Tyson, examine these topics: Dog Genius; Creative Dolphins; Octopus And Cuttlefish; and a profile of scientist Irene Pepperberg, who has revolutionized scientists’ ideas about animal communication and intelligence.
Explore traits we once thought were uniquely ours- language, tool-making, even laughter- to uncover their evolutionary roots.

p.t: scienceNOW: How Smart Can We Get?
p.d: How Smart Can We Get? How do you get a genius brain? Is it all in the genes? Or is it hard work? Episodes include: Einstein's Brain; Mystery of the Savant Brain; What is Intelligence?; and Profile: Sian Beilock.

Terrorists target airliners, exploiting security gaps with bombs in drinks, shoes, and more. Air Crash Confidential explores this cat-and-mouse game with evolving threats and countermeasures like metal detectors, body scanners, and vigilant officers.

Aircraft collisions are among the deadliest accidents.Despite millions spent on solutions, new issues arise. Key incidents and stories from survivors and a grieving father who took revenge after losing his family highlight why these problems persist.

Pilot error has caused many air crashes. The film examines incidents like the 1972 London and 2001 Queens crashes. Computer-controlled aircraft introduced new issues, seen in Qantas Flight 72's 2008 plunge and Air France Flight 447's 2009 disappearance.

Fire on Board details aviation's struggle with in-flight fires, like the 2007 China Airlines blaze, the 1985 Manchester fire and 1983 Air Canada Flight 797 disaster. The 1998 Swissair Flight 111 crash underscores persistent fire safety challenges.

Modern technology lets planes fly in tough weather, but it can cause an increase of air crashes. Extreme Weather tells of Julianne Koepcke's survival after lightning struck her Amazon flight. It covers Toronto's wind shear incident and Poland's fog crash.

Aircrash Confidental explores aviation's battle with engineering errors, from DC10 disasters to Jumbo Jet's explosion. Despite Boeing 747's safety, TWA Flight 800's 1996 explosion reveals risks. The industry learns, improving safety in modern aircraft.

A tornado is a violently rotating column of air extending from the base of a thunderstorm down to the ground. Tornadoes are capable of completely destroying well-made structures, uprooting trees, and hurling objects through the air like deadly missiles.

Sherlock Holmes is awakened in modern times with a tale that he had invented a method of suspended animation that he had used on himself. Awakened by an earthquake, he is helped by Amy Winslow, who lives at 1994 Baker Street in San Francisco.
Holmes urgently tries to find the location of a bomb that was placed somewhere in London.
The detectives create a plan to trap a killer before he murders his 7th wife.
When a gentlewoman is found dead with her throat torn out, the villagers blame a supernatural monster. But Sherlock Holmes, who gets drawn into the case from nearby Quebec, suspects a human murderer.
A murder mystery set on a speeding train, Holmes guards the transport of the 400-carat diamond. In Vibrant Colour!
'Escape artist' Crocker, escapes from the police to ask Holmes to clear him from a murder charge.
Holmes invites the good doctor to their first murder investigation.

p.t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Diamond Tooth
p.d: While walking along the banks of the River Thames, Watson finds a diamond tooth. The article takes on more meaning later, however, when Holmes learns that the body of a murder victim had been discovered near where Watson found the tooth.
Margaret Martini's fiancee is missing, but the trail to his whereabouts leads to 7 other murders.
Minnie, a cowgirl from a travelling western show, visits Holmes after she finds a dead body in her room.

p.t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Impromptu Performance
p.d: A condemned man scheduled to hang the next day uses his last request to ask Sherlock Holmes to prove his innocence of the murder for which he is about to be executed.
Holmes uncovers a serious mystery when helping one of Watson's old friends.

p.t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Unlucky Gambler
p.d: A young boy shows up at Baker Street, asking for Holmes' help in finding his missing father.

p.t: Sherlock Holmes: The Case of the Tyrant's Daughter
p.d: A chemist is accused of the murder of his fiancé's stepfather, who was determined to keep the two apart.
A French interpreter urgently needs the detective, as criminals try to take him to their hide out.

Holly (Kristen Johnston), determined to find Stuart (David Alan Basche) a date, introduces him to a woman who turns out to be a true professional. Haskell (Wayne Knight) invents a fabulous online lifestyle for himself in order to one-up his ex-wife.

Phil (Donald Faison) meets a foreign lingerie model who doesn’t speak English and Stuart (David Alan Basche) has to act as interpreter. Eden helps Holly overcome a bad first impression with a handsome neighbor. Haskell buys a coffin as an investment.

Phil (Donald Faison), Stuart (David Alan Basche), and Haskell (Wayne Knight) are forced to trade apartments with Holly (Kristen Johnston) when her mother (Judith Light) comes for a visit because Holly never told her mother her engagement ended months ago.

p.t: The Odd Couple: Madison And Son
p.d: Oscar's dream comes true when he is asked to throw out the first pitch at a New York Mets game.
Oscar attempts to impress Charlotte (Teri Hatcher) by purchasing a table for a fundraiser to benefit The New York Philharmonic.

p.t: The Odd Couple: An Oscar Named Desire
p.d: Oscar and Charlotte hit a speed bump when they hesitate to take their relationship to the next level.

p.t: The Odd Couple: Make Room For Dani
p.d: Oscar reluctantly agrees with his agent that it's time to shake things up on his radio show and allows Dani to have a bigger role after a rival host, Rich Eisen, taunts him.

p.t: The Odd Couple: A Dinner Engagement
p.d: Felix attempts to reverse Emily's birthday curse and plans a nice dinner to celebrate with friends.

p.t: Are We There Yet?: The Bigg Box Klub Episode
p.d: Nick goes crazy buying items in bulk that the family doesn't need at the The Big Box Club, discount super store.

p.t: Are We There Yet?: The Black Friday Episode
p.d: Comical chaos ensues when the gang waits in line to shop at a department store on Black Friday. Here, Kevin anticipates buying a new video game, Lindsey meets a boy, relationship problems plague Martin and Terrence hopes to buy toys for charity.

p.t: Are We There Yet?: The Blackout Episode
p.d: A guys' night out goes awry, resulting in lost recollections due to alcohol-fueled blackouts and the disappearance of Nick's wedding ring.

p.t: Are We There Yet?: The Wrong Way Episode
p.d: Nick attends his high-school reunion but must face an embarrassing incident from his past. Meanwhile, Lindsey throws a party.

p.t: Are We There Yet?: The Concussion Episode
p.d: Nick suffers a concussion.

p.t: Are We There Yet?: The Bucket List Episode
p.d: Nick worries about his mortality and creates a bucket list featuring overly dangerous activities. Meanwhile, Kevin and Troy launch an underground candy ring at school.

p.t: Are We There Yet?: The Spelling Bee Episode
p.d: Nick meets a famous actor, who shadows Nick in preparation for a role. Meanwhile, Kevin gears up for a spelling bee.

p.t: Hunting the Edge of Space: The Ever Expanding Universe
p.d: The Ever-Expanding Universe investigates a battery of high-tech telescopes that are joining the Hubble Space Telescope on its quest to unlock the secrets of our universe, a cosmos almost incomprehensible in its size, age and violence.

p.t: In the Shadow of the Moon
p.d: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

p.t: Inside Outer Space: Episode 5: Space Missions
p.d: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

p.t: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
p.d: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.
Neil Armstrong has stamped his place in history by becoming the first person to walk on the moon.

Catastrophe beckons when gears controlling a Single Point of Failure Space Shuttle landing system are installed backwards. And despite multiple pressures, a shocking discovery causes NASA to cancel a historic launch.

p.t: Space Mistakes: The End of Genesis
p.d: A spacecraft freefalls from orbit smashing into the ground when its parachute fails to deploy. Can the multi-million dollar science mission be salvaged? And, a wrong turn ruptures a costly Space Shuttle cold plate!

p.t: Space Mistakes: Trains, Rockets and Pains
p.d: A harrowing space mistake leaves the solid rocket boosters hanging by a thread and places the unsuspecting public in the cross hairs of more than a ton of the most explosive rocket fuel on the planet. And, a training exercise goes horribly wrong.

After attempting to murder a woman he's convinced tried to kill him in a past life, a man is committed to a hospital for the criminally insane, but a suspicious District Attorney is convinced that the man has killed before.

When her daughter is diagnosed with leukemia, a woman (Alexandra Paul) and her new husband get pulled into the whirlwind life of her seedy ex-husband who tries to extort money from them in exchange for his life-saving bone marrow.
After the unsolved fatal hit-and-run of a woman's father, a devious plan for revenge reveals the shocking truth behind his death.

Starring Paula Trickey, Thomas Calabro, and Al Sapienza. When a popular Philadelphia restaurant critic suspects that her husband is cheating on her, she hires a private investigator who turns out to have his own agenda.
A twisted psychological thriller about a man haunted by his past.
In this suspenseful thriller, a high-priced and ruthless jury consultant will stop at nothing to secure a verdict on an explosive trial.

In the dark heart of a sprawling, anonymous city, Terminal follows the twisting tales of two assassins carrying out a sinister mission (Max Irons And Dexter Fletcher), a teacher battling a fatal illness (Simon Pegg), an enigmatic janitor (Mike Myers)...
A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.
A jilted fan soon finds himself pulled into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse after he accepts the opportunity to spy on his favorite actress via his laptop.
Winner of 3 Academy Awards including BEST PICTURE, A car accident brings together a group of strangers in Los Angeles.

A psychotic woman goes to murderous lengths to protect her relationship with her new grandchildren.

Beat battles a stuck truck in the middle of the night, then builds in darkness to meet his deadline on a home in northern Ontario.
On a two-man build in Alberta, Joel and his right-hand man Shawn are challenged by broken logs and stubborn headers.
In upstate New York, Beat builds three grandiose gazebos for two brothers with neighbouring properties. Back home, Bryan Jr. asks his son Little Man to take charge of his first build ever.
Joel assembles a millionaire’s retreat on a private island in England, Beat gets an emotional assignment, and Peter cannot take a vacation until he completes an HQ remodel for The Chief’s return.

p.t: Timber Kings: Take to the Trees
p.d: Peter may have met his match when he builds a mountainside ski cabin for a client experienced in log-home building.
Peter battles the elements to build a retirement home for childhood sweethearts, while Bryan Jr. constructs an entryway for his own sweetheart - wife Tabby.
Alan is convinced there's jade under a pit full of water on their Dynasty claim. Josh's mechanical skills are tested while trying to get a giant boulder to a new buyer.
Mining season starts and, while the jade proves elusive, a trucking accident turns into a bonanza for Jade City.
The season's first huge boulder is brought back to camp and put under the saw. A first-aid emergency forces Josh into action with his newly-minted training.
Claudia, Robin and the crew scramble to get their heavy equipment up a mountain before rising rivers make it impossible to get to the mining claim.
Bad brakes, frazzled nerves, and a rough road have Claudia doubting her crew can haul their huge bunkhouse to camp in one piece.
Claudia gets stressed out trying to get their best jade ready for buyers, while her crew's morale is tested as they battle the cold to finally start cutting the 90-tonne boulder.
Subzero temperatures challenge the Jade City miners rushing to hit the jackpot-a jade boulder big enough to impress the investors before the season ends.
Tensions boil over as the overseas investors drop by unexpectedly to check up on work at the Wolverine mining site and Alan tries to make peace.
Tensions come to a boil as Claudia, Robin, and the crew attempt to get people and equipment to their remote jade camp.
A confidence man is aided by the drovers and promptly shows his gratitude by stealing the ownership papers of the herd.
Trail boss Gil Favor hires a hunter to protect his herd from an escaped circus lion the hunter is tracking down.
Mushy Musgrove's poker take proves so troublesome to him that he purposely attempts to lose the winnings in another game.
A girl helps Hey Soos, who has disobeyed orders, regain the favor of his bosses.
Gil Favor and his drovers fight to save a mentally disturbed woman from being burned as a witch by the Cheyenne Indians.
Three brothers mistake Wishbone for their sister's fiancé and try to strong-arm him into marriage.
Wishbone becomes blind after a bad fall from a steep cliff, saving him only by desperate grab at a convenient bush.
A beautiful woman whose possessions include a porcelain tub, a suit of armor and four Scottish bulls is rescued by Rowdy and Quince.
The drovers face a full-scale war if the U.S. Army doesn't fulfill the terms of a treaty it made with an Apache Indian tribe.
An orphanage operator sells some of Gil Favor's cattle, scattered by a storm, in the naive belief that they're strays.
Trail boss Gil Favor catches a horse thief who turns out to be a former friend of Wishbone, the camp cook.
A black-garbed man walks into the drovers' camp during a thunderstorm, but his clothing is absolutely dry.

When outlaws invade the home of a seemingly innocent, frontier family, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues. This leads to seduction, and ultimately bloody revenge. Starring: Chad Michael Murray, Francesca Eastwood, Luke Wilson.

In 1883, Geronimo and his small group of Apache warriors, under constant attack from both U.S. and Mexican military forces, reluctantly surrender in exchange for food and land. But promises are broken, and the Apaches declare all-out war on the U.S.

A man on the run is surprised to learn that he is a Knights Templar and that his girlfriend is a holy virgin about to give birth to a very special baby on Christmas Day. Starring: Willem Dafoe, Jared Harris, Olivier Martinez, Michelle Forbes
After one last contest battle between Ash and May, our heroes go their separate ways, and Ash discovers his next adventure!

Ash Ketchum, a 10-year-old from Pallet Town, is finally old enough to receive his first Pokémon! However, he oversleeps, and the only remaining Pokémon at Professor Oak’s lab is a strong-willed Pikachu!
Ash rushes into Viridian City with his wounded Pikachu, where he encounters Jessie, James, and Meowth of Team Rocket, as well as Misty, who’s angry about Ash wrecking her bike!
Ash discovers and catches his first Pokémon! Though he’s excited, Misty is grossed out by his new Bug-type Pokémon friend.
An angry swarm of Beedrill attacks Ash and Samurai in the midst of a Metapod standoff! Ash flees, leaving behind his Metapod, who is mad at him for abandoning it.

Ash challenges the Pewter City Gym Leader, Brock, but even Pikachu has no chance against Brock’s Rock-type Pokémon. With the mysterious Flint helping him, it’s time for Ash to train hard before the rematch!
A scientist leads Ash and his friends deep into Mt. Moon to find the storied Moon Stone, which is said to increase the power of Pokémon!
Ash seeks the Cascade Badge in Cerulean City—but for some reason, Misty doesn’t want to join him.

After earning his second badge, Ash sets off triumphantly for Vermilion City. Along the way, he hears of AJ, a Trainer on the brink of 100 straight victories. Full of confidence, Ash challenges this fearsome Trainer!
Ash meets some students, who are bullying their classmate Joe. Joe insists the rough treatment is necessary so he’ll be strong enough to graduate. Ash doesn’t agree.
Completely lost, our heroes reach a village not shown on their map. This quiet place is inhabited by Pokémon that have been injured in battle or abandoned by their Trainers.
As our heroes press on toward Vermilion City, they encounter an injured Charmander, sitting atop a stone on a mountain pass. They later find out why it is waiting there.
Ash and his friends walk along a path and fall into a hole dug by a group of mischievous Squirtle. Why is the Squirtle Squad such a menace to the local population?
The party meets Bill, a Pokémon researcher who is waiting in his lighthouse for the coming of a one-of-a-kind Pokémon, never before seen by humans. Could such a Pokémon truly exist?

Eager to earn a badge, Ash challenges Lt. Surge. Pikachu reluctantly enters the battle, only to discover that its opponent is a Raichu, a fierce Pokémon with tremendous electric power—and the evolved form of Pikachu!
Captain Garfield's ship is under attack by pirates who are after his treasure.
Things soon get out of hand when Garfield gets his paws on Dr. Bonkers cloning ray.
Garfield tries to exploit Vito's speedy pizza delivery pledge to get free pies.
Odie wreaks havoc around town after eating a Mexican jumping bean Jon received from his friend, Pablo.
Odie plays detective after Jon is wrongly accused of stealing Mrs Shmidlap's bracelet.
Tired of living in a dustbin, alley cat Bruno decides to make Garfield's home his own.
Garfield and Odie try to save Vito's Pizzeria from real estate tycoon Brent Mogul.
Garfield is turned black and white as punishment.
Garfield and Odie think they're saved from having to stay with Aunt Ivy after Paddy the leprechaun appears, makes it rain and ruins Jon and Liz's beach holiday.
Garfield and Odie discover talking fish in the sea.
The movie genre which provides this week's theme is fairy tales, and the contestants have to rescue a fairy princess. Their first challenge is to walk across a rope bridge.
The contestants' next challenge has mystery movies as a theme. They have to solve the clues and follow the trail to solve the crime.
It's announced that Owen is returning to the show, but the contestants don't know he's been bribed to stir up trouble. The theme of the new challenge is rock 'n' roll biopics.
The latest challenge involves the boys competing against the girls at kung fu. They also have to brew tea at the top of a mountain for a kung fu master.

The next challenge involves sci-fi movies, with contestants having to sleep in zero gravity and fly a jet simulator. Their biggest challenge is to see how long they can last in the G-Force trainer, or 'vomit comet'.

Sydney's roommate from school is on track of a pendant from her past and enlists Sydney to help find it and catch the killer.

p.t: Relic Hunter: The Light of Truth
p.d: Arabia 843 AD: A sheik uses the Light of Truth to reveal his general as a traitor. 2001: Prince Shareem drops out from Sydney's class to go search for the Light of Truth.
Sydney's on the hunt for a Pirate's booty, but will a traitor force her to walk the plank?

p.t: Relic Hunter: Women Want to Know
p.d: Sydney has found a temple with an idol of Ganesha and it is being filmed for TV, but they get trapped inside when the local rebels stumble onto them. Can Nigel and Karen help from USA?

p.t: Relic Hunter: The Star of Nadir
p.d: An anonymous Sultan's wife Danielle dies in mysterious circumstances in the desert. However, she had called for Sydney to help. Sydney believes Danielle was searching for the Star of Nadir.
A guide leads Sydney and Nigel to an unusual, underground Aztec burial chamber. Instead of a body, they find a relic.
Retrieving a mythical lancet, Sydney and Nigel run into Nigel's look-alike just before his death. Nigel gets a cut from the lancet. Later, Cate persuades Nigel to impersonate the man.
Carson Inez, a collector, uses an ancient necklace to get Sydney to help her in raising Athena who will then help her conquer the world.

p.t: Relic Hunter: Warlock of Nu Theta Phi
p.d: When Sydney's student Meg's roommate finds a witch's amulet, it hospitalizes Meg. Meg's boyfriend's fraternity brother races to get the amulet. What is he up to?

p.t: Relic Hunter: Fire in the Sky
p.d: While Sydney is lecturing about the Native Americans who faced a mysterious cataclysm 600 years earlier, a native brings her a relic from that era. What is its secret?

p.t: Relic Hunter: Hunting with the Enemy
p.d: An urn commissioned in a Cambodian monastery by the Chinese emperor for the remains of Confucius is about to be destroyed by systematic bombing of a whole province.
Despite terrible weather, Sidney drags Nigel along to an Arctic base where an ancient Indian mummy has been found, who turns out to be an Anasazi.
Sydney and Nigel travel to Istanbul to investigate the death of one Sydney's friends, a professor who was trying to prove Hercules did exist by finding the Belt of Hippolyte.
When Nigel is charmed by brilliant student Lorraine to show her their offices (and kiss), a burglar knocks out Sidney, but what was robbed?
Sidney inherits from the best relic hunter of the previous generation a key and rushes with Nigel on the hunt for the one treasure he never found: Pandora's box.

On the tropical island of Sulawesi, Indonesia, a tourist snorkeller and several local fishermen have been killed and injured by a mysterious sea creature that impales its victims. Wade travels to the scene to investigate.
Jeremy Wade homes in on a predator now invading America's backyards. Said to breathe air and crawl on land, the snakehead is rumoured to be able to kill a human.
In the jungles of South America, Jeremy tracks down a fish that has attacked a diver.
Jeremy Wade travels the United States in search of river monsters living in the nation's waterways. He goes from the Indian River Lagoon in Florida to the Lake of the Ozarks in Missouri.
Jeremy travels to Central America to locate a man-sized beast that reportedly leaps into boats and inflicts devastating injuries upon fishermen.
Jeremy is in Japan on the trail of the kappa. He must uncover the truth behind the myths and possibly even catch one of these beasts.
Jeremy tracks down eyewitnesses and survivors of piranha attacks, uncovering the fear behind the man-eater.
Extreme angler Jeremy Wade travels to the Bahamas after hearing tales of swimmers being ripped from the surface of blue holes surrounding the Paradise Island.
Jeremy tracks down eyewitnesses and survivors of piranha attacks, uncovering the fear behind the man-eater.
Extreme fishing series. Jeremy investigates three mysterious deaths in three South American countries on his most remote mission to date.
Jeremy goes on a dangerous mission from the Sea of Cortez in Mexico to Peru where he discovers a deep-sea devil.
A behind-the-scenes episode where Jeremy reveals just what it takes to move river monsters into the open ocean and the crew opens up about their struggles on board.
The Sobral Santos went down in history as the Amazon's worst ever boating disaster. Hundreds died, but for Jeremy Wade there is an unexplained and disturbing detail about the stricken passengers.
Jeremy investigates the case of a Bolivian man who had his face ripped off by a ferocious river predator, leading to a showdown with an old adversary.
Extreme angler Jeremy embarks on a punishing mission to the Pacific Northwest to find an ancient river monster said to rise from the depths to attack swimmers.

Andy is partnered with Swarek’s new girlfriend, Officer Marlo Cruz. When they come face-to-face with an out of control EDP [Emotionally Disturbed Person], their differences are put to the test and one of them has to pull the trigger.

p.t: Rookie Blue: The Kids Are Not Alright
p.d: Andy has her sights set on a much-needed long weekend. But when a routine highway check leads to the discovery of a teenage boy in the trunk of a car, Andy and Gail must convince him that no heartache lasts forever

After a messy drug arrest, Andy and Marlo are quarantined together. Meanwhile, 15 Division springs into emergency response mode in order to get the contaminated drugs off the streets before a deadly outbreak sweeps through the city.

When a young woman is reported missing, the officers of 15 Division soon discover a possible copycat connection to one of their division’s most distressing cases. With the clock ticking, Gail must face her worst fears..
When human bones found in a ravine open up a 15-year-old missing persons case, Swarek reunites with his old training officer to solve the case

p.t: Rookie Blue: For Better, For Worse
p.d: Everyone at 15 Division, especially Andy, just wants a quick, smooth shift so they can get to Frank and Noelle’s wedding. But things get complicated when they get called to a hijacked casino bus full of senior citizens
When Chris returns for a visit, his reunion takes a shocking turn when his son, Christian, is abducted while under the care of Andy and Nick
Near the end of shift, 15 Division busts a marijuana grow-op – a case that becomes Traci’s first homicide and forces Andy, Nick and Gail to work overtime
When a suspected pedophile is found beaten within an inch of his life, Andy discovers Marlo has been conducting a mania-fueled, off-hours “investigation”
After Andy and Chloe take fire from an unseen shooter, the officers realize they are the targets of someone with a grudge against 15 Division

p.t: Rookie Blue: You Can See the Stars
p.d: In the wake of a targeted attack on the officers of 15 Division (ep. 412), Andy, Swarek, and their fellow officers have to piece together the truth about a past crime in order to find Oliver Shaw – in time to save his life
In the aftermath of the night’s traumatic events, Andy and Dov try to pull themselves together at an all-night diner, but are caught off-duty and off-guard in a volatile diner hold-up.

p.t: Rookie Blue: All by Her Selfie
p.d: Oliver gets promoted and Andy is tasked with training 15 Division’s newest rookie, Duncan Moore. But when Andy and Duncan respond to a messy homicide at a pawnshop, it’s clear this rookie is going to give Andy the challenge of a lifetime.

p.t: Rookie Blue: Heart Breakers, Money Makers
p.d: When Andy and Nick’s seizure at an illegal gambling house leads to a suspicious confession, Andy recruits Sam to help figure out who’s lying, why, and where the money is, before anyone gets hurt.
When a tenement-building shooting leads to the discovery of an executed gang leader, 15 Division must race to find the killer before a gang war breaks out
