p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Sabrina Through The Looking Glass
p.d: Sabrina's in a foul mood and only baseball great Brady Anderson can help her out of her slump.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Hilda And Zelda: The Teenage Years
p.d: Aunts Hilda and Zelda experience growing pains when they turn into teenagers for the night.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Mars Attracts
p.d: A winter vacation to Mars and a cute ski instructor test Sabrina’s feelings for Harvey.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: First Kiss
p.d: Sabrina’s first kiss becomes a test of true love when Harvey is turned into a frog.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Sweet Charity
p.d: When Sabrina uses Libby’s likeness to promote a community service program, the real Libby manages to steal the limelight.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Cat Showdown
p.d: Salem enters a cat show to make some fast cash, but Sabrina uncovers a fur-raising scandal.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Meeting Dad’s Girlfriend
p.d: Love definitely isn’t in the air when Sabrina meets her dad’s new girlfriend.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: As Westbridge Turns
p.d: Sinister plots, tumultuous romance, danger, and intrigue – just another day at Westbridge High, after Sabrina casts a spell wishing for more excitement.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: The Great Mistake
p.d: Sabrina finds herself in a little trouble when she sneaks out of the house after being grounded.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: The Crucible
p.d: Sabrina is put on trial for witchcraft when her class visits historical Salem, Massachusetts.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: The Troll Bride
p.d: When Sabrina is tricked into marrying a troll, only a prince – a.k.a. Harvey – can save her.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Sabrina Gets Her License (Part 1)
p.d: Sabrina's 17th birthday turns stressful when she has to start studying for her witch's license.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Sabrina Gets Her License (Part 2)
p.d: Sabrina learns about the responsibilities that come with using magic when she earns her witch’s learner’s permit.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Dummy For Love
p.d: Sabrina takes advantage of Vice Principal Kraft’s attraction to Aunt Hilda.

p.t: Sabrina: The Teenage Witch: Dante’s Inferno
p.d: Sabrina learns not to date outside of her realm after a bad evening with a witch boy.
Sam, Colby and Nate explore deep inside the world's largest catacombs in Odesa, Ukraine.
Sam and Colby stay overnight at the haunted Fairfield County Infirmary.
Sam and Colby experience a terrifying night alone at a haunted lighthouse in St. Augustine, Florida.
Sam and Colby investigate the Shadow Man Manor overnight.
Sam and Colby investigate the demon in Bell Witch Cave, a.k.a. America's scariest ghost story.
Join Sam and Colby as they spend a night in the legendary Conjuring House.
Sam and Colby bravely face the spirits inhabiting America's most haunted ship.
Sam and Colby spend a night delving into the terrifying paranormal mysteries inside the Sallie House.
Sam and Colby are the newest guests at America's most frightening hotel, the Shanley.
Sam and Colby face the mysteries and spirits inhabiting America's most haunted house, the Whaley House.
Join Sam and Colby as they find out if Robert is truly the most haunted doll in the world.
Join Sam and Colby as they explore a seemingly abandoned hospital in New York.
Join Sam and Colby as they attempt to solve the mystery of the Black Swann Inn murders.
Sam and Colby venture to America's most haunted and famous prison, the Mansfield State Penitentiary.
Sam and Colby are joined by their friends to explore the most haunted ship in America.
The HMAS Hammersley attempts the daring capture of an illegal fishing 'mother ship', but they are thwarted by violent eco-terrorists intent on sinking the fishing boat.
The crew uncovers a people-smuggling racket when they almost collide with a floating shipping container full of North Korean refugees.
The men of the Hammersley are smitten by a female sailor with a rescue fetish. Meanwhile, several crew members succumb to food poisoning - or is it something more sinister?
Spider saves the life of a boy after discovering an unexploded sea mine, washed ashore during a cyclone.
Disaster looms for the Hammersley when a fire erupts in the engine room, after the mascot is stolen by a rival Patrol Boat crew.
The crew pursues a distraught father who has kidnapped his own children. Then, while searching a crocodile-infested swamp for the missing family, the crew discovers a badly mauled fisherman.
The Hammersley saves sailors from a sinking ship, only to learn they are diamond smugglers who will kill to save their cargo.
The Hammersley races to save a boatload of tourists from being murdered as part of a bizarre terrorist publicity stunt.
The crew risks life and ship to hunt down a rogue terrorist boat and retrieve its cargo of bio-toxins.
After rescuing aid workers from the Samaru islands, the HMAS Hammersley engages a fishing vessel straying into Australian waters.

Despite being determined to earn respect, Hammersley's new chef Bomber Brown but faces discipline after losing her temper with another crew member. Also, the crew discover a dead pirate and a killer cargo on board a stolen boat.
The Hammersley is hijacked by a mysterious gang of illegal immigrants who are determined to flee Australian water. Lives are at stake when Nikki and Kate are taken hostage on board.
Kate's romantic life is looking up after a blind date with an SAS commander. Mike needs all his diplomacy skills when a sexy French naval captain tries to seduce him.
Robert fails a drug test but is determined to prove his innocence. Meanwhile, the Hammersley uncovers a smuggling operation by Samaruian rebels which is designed to destabilise the government.
Nikki is sexually harassed and blackmailed over her secret affair with ET. The crew are exposed to deadly avian flu while arresting illegal fishermen.
In 2004, Brendan Percy was found dead of hypothermia and dehydration in a sub alpine area above Oamaru in suspicious circumstances.

p.t: Sensing Murder: A Bump in the Night
p.d: In 1980, six-year-old Alicia O'Reilly was raped and murdered in her bed, while her sister slept less than a metre away, and her mother sleeping across the hallway.

Garth Doull trained to be a policeman but the lure of the race track saw him swap sides of the law to become a consummate con-man. On the 8th of September 1989, his body was found floating in Wellington harbour.
In 1985, 25-year-old Luana 'La Verne' Williams disappeared from her Tauranga home. Eight years later her disappearance was upgraged to a murder enquiry. Her body has never been found.
In 1970, eighteen-year-old Olive Waiker disappeared as she walked across Rotorua to babysit her nieces and nephews. Her semi-naked body was found hours later in a rest area south of the city..

p.t: Sensing Murder: Now You See Me
p.d: 26-year-old deaf woman Alexa Cullen vanished from her home in Manaia, on the Coromandel Peninsular in 1995. She had a history of hitch-hiking and police suspected she’d run away. But three years later, ominous rumors began circulating in the community.

p.t: Sensing Murder: Sensing Murder Insights - Special
p.d: Police detectives from around New Zealand reveal exciting new developments sparked by the Sensing Murder psychics in Series 1.

p.t: Sensing Murder: Girl in The Ditch
p.d: When 12 year old Agnes Ali'iva'a drowned in a ditch in 1992, the police initially thought her death was accidental. It was four years before public and political pressure forced police to re-investigate her death.

“Sensing Murder” psychics are challenged to connect with the spirit of murdered Christchurch scrap-metal dealer, John Reynolds, to discover his killer and reveal the truth surrounding the violent attack.

Katikati man Siegfried Newman disappeared on February 25, 2008, after he had dropped his sons Thomas, 9, and Oliver, 7, at Pahoia School. Police carried out a three-day search but found no sign of him.
65-year-old Alan Gordon Woodford of Bedford St. Mossburn left his home on foot Saturday morning April 20, 1985 and was never seen or heard of again.

19-year-old Joan Wech left New Zealand for the bright lights of Sydney. But the first step on her overseas adventure would be her last. Was this a robbery gone wrong, a savage random attack or a revenge killing by a jealous ex-lover?

p.t: Sensing Murder: A Mother's Worst Nightmare
p.d: Otautau toddler Amber-Lee, aged two and a half, vanished from Kingston at the southern tip of Lake Wakatipu on October 17, 1992.
In 1993, devoted father Kevin O'Loughlin came face to face with the dark side of sunny Nelson when he was brutally stabbed to death after a night out on the town.

This week’s episode of Sensing Murder promises greater co-operation between psychics and police, attempting to uncover the truth about the death of 18-year-old apprentice plumber Regan O’Donoghue, who was killed in a hit and run in 2007.
At Tamera's urging, Lisa hires a new assistant, Todd Banks, an attractive young male graduate who turns out to be lazy on the job. After a number of screw-ups, Lisa fires him.
Ray's run for State Senate has his family up in arms after their lives become an open book in the press.

p.t: Sister, Sister: The Grass Is Always Finer
p.d: Tia's crush on a handsome teacher leaves her shaken, stirred, and on the rocks with her boyfriend.
Tia's experiment has Jordan and Tyreke at each other's throats, while Tamera and her dad face off in a political showdown!
Jordan and Tyreke find themselves escorting two young coeds to the Homecoming Dance --- until girlfriends Tia and Tamera decide to show up at the last minute!
Tia faces a tough choice among competing sororities; while Jordan also learns a lesson about the Greek.
Jordan confronts his fears when Tamera and friends convince him that love is a two-way street.

Ray is frustrated that his political campaign is not allowing him the time to get to the heart of the issues with his constituents. His campaign manager has been driving Ray hard, and the results are starting to make an impact.
Tia gets cold feet after agreeing to take an exam for her twin sister.
It's a game of musical dates as the girls' family and friends switch partners for a night on the town.

p.t: Sister, Sister: Two Guys, A Girl, and a Calendar
p.d: Tia and Tamera battle it out on behalf of their guys as competition gets tight for a spot in their school's 12 Most Gorgeous Men on Campus calendar.
Tamera lands a job as a radio talk show hostess dispensing advice on love on romance, including her own sister Tia's -- but without Tia's permission!
The twins think a photojournalist visiting campus may be their biological father.

p.t: Sister, Sister: I Know What You Did In Drama Class
p.d: Diavian and Tyreke become partners in drama class but Tia flips out after catching them in a passionate kiss during a drama rehearsal. Tamera and Jordan try to hook up cable in the girl's room
Jordan's guest shot on Tamera's radio show turns into a full-time gig, but it may cost them their friendship.
A potential threat to an airplane full of officials sends Steve in search of a stolen missile in a mountain lumber camp.
Steve befriends a boy (Rodney Allen Rippy) while investigating smugglers trying to crack the government's defense system.
A chemical put on government documents is Steve's only lead to learning whether a friend (Louis Gossett Jr.) is a traitor.
Steve and an ESP expert form a magic act to infiltrate a club whose owner's organization has stolen a top-secret codebook.
While pursuing the legendary Bigfoot, Steve finds a group of aliens in imminent danger from an earthquake.
A beautiful thief (Farrah Fawcett-Majors) agrees to help Steve retrieve a valuable statue stolen from a small country.
Steve escorts a pretty Soviet gymnast (Cathy Rigby) and her troupe on a tour of the United States.
Steve probes a ring peddling nuclear missiles on the black market; guests Britt Ekland, David McCallum.
Steve snatches a U.S. ambassador from a kidnap ring, but a statesman is then taken; guest Leif Erickson.
The ransom in gold for the kidnapped statesman is stolen en route; guest Elizabeth Ashley.
Plane-crash survivors Steve and Oscar still face a threat from a group attempting to sabotage international negotiations.
Steve and a clairvoyant girl search for a missing scientist in the Everglades; guest Pamela Franklin.
Assigned to keep a secret missile-guidance system out of foreign hands, Steve must confront a robot constructed to kill.
Steve must repair a damaged plane to escape from an African country with proof of U.N.-treaty violations; guest Greg Morris.
Steve rushes to an island space-installation to rescue his friends from a self-destruct weapon triggered by an earthquake.
Leah and Jeremy get serious, while Chelsea breaks down on Adam's birthday. Jenelle questions if Andrew is really Jace's, while Kailyn is asked out on a date. (S3, ep11)

p.t: Teen Mom 2: A Means To An End
p.d: Leah has some big news for Corey, while Chelsea gets ready for beauty school. Jenelle goes through with the paternity test while Kailyn and Jo get into a huge fight over his new girlfriend. (S3, ep12)
Dr Drew hosts a look back at the hilarious highs and the difficult lows never before seen with Kailyn, Leah, Jenelle and Chelsea from the third season of Teen Mom 2.

p.t: Teen Mom 2: Season 3 Finale Special: Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 1
p.d: Dr Drew hosts the Teen Moms in front of a live audience. Jenelle sits down with Jace's dad for the first time in years and Chelsea continues to hold on to Adam despite her father's frustrations.

p.t: Teen Mom 2: Season 3 Finale Special: Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 2
p.d: Dr Drew hosts the Teen Moms in front of a live studio audience. Leah reveals some tragic news about her pregnancy and Kailyn struggles to accept Jo's new girlfriend.
Leah faces re-emerging feelings for Corey. Jenelle and Gary spend time with Jace. Kailyn and Jo get into a physical fight. Chelsea is worried she might be pregnant again. (S4, ep1)
Kailyn and Jo go to court. Chelsea has her first day of beauty school. Leah expresses strong feelings for Corey and Jenelle finds out that Gary had sex with her best friend. (S4, ep2)

p.t: Teen Mom 2: The Future is Now
p.d: Leah is torn between Corey and Jeremy. Adam texts Chelsea to see Aubree, but it doesn't go as planned. Jenelle finishes probation and Kailyn takes Isaac to Jo's. (S4, ep3)
Kieffer and Jenelle are dating again. Kailyn tries to take Jo to court to change their custody agreement. Chelsea tells her mum about the pregnancy scare. (S4, ep4)
Gary and Jenelle are back together and she tries to be more responsible. Kailyn has a violent outburst toward Javi. Chelsea finds out about Adam's new girlfriend and Leah plans her wedding. (S4, ep6)

p.t: Teen Mom 2: For Better or For Worse
p.d: Leah and Jeremy have a courthouse wedding. Adam tries to make Chelsea jealous. Gary has a big surprise for Jenelle. Kailyn and Javi discuss joining the military and getting married. (S4, ep7)
Gary and Jenelle get into an altercation which lands them both in jail. Chelsea talks to her lawyer about Adam's strange legal letter. Kailyn and Javi consider getting married in Las Vegas. (S4, ep8)
Leah reaches out to her biological dad and Jenelle goes to court to face the charges from the Gary fight. Javi passes his Air Force test and he and Kail seriously talk marriage. (S4, ep9)

p.t: Teen Mom 2: For Love and Money
p.d: Javi has a big surprise for Kailyn. Jenelle, Barb, and Kieffer celebrate Jace's 3rd birthday but Jenelle reveals she has some serious money problems. Chelsea celebrates her 21st birthday. (S4, ep10)
Jenelle learns that she has very little chance of getting custody of Jace. Leah takes Ali to a neuromuscular specialist and Kailyn finally tells Jo about her plans with Javi. (S4, ep11)
The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song.
The Teletubbies watch a girl a called Rebecca, who shows us her dogs doing some tricks. A swing appears in Teletubbyland, and Laa-Laa plays on the swing.
Laa-Laa wants to play indoors. She asks Po, Dipsy and Tinky Winky to play indoors too, but they want to play outdoors.
The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland.
Teletubbies love dancing, but everything stops when the Teletubbies watch two boys play with their Mum's Keyboard.
Laa-Laa has fun wearing Dipsy's hat. The Teletubbies watch Emily washing her pony, Jester. The Teletubbies enjoy playing a game washing with their Tubby sponges.
The Teletubbies watch some children making bubbles. Magic things happen when Laa-Laa bounces her ball all over Teletubbyland.
The Teletubbies meet to watch some children have great fun watering the garden. The Teletubbies play a hiding game.
The Teletubbies watch Oliver and his Llama. Po is feeling happy. She jumps and skips over Teletubbyland singing to herself.
Laa-Laa has no time for Tubby custard before watching some children make ice-lollies by freezing their favourite juice. The Teletubbies giggle as they all try to do everything together.
The Tubbies watch Andy Brown and some children look in a river for otters. Dipsy and Po play together.

The Teletubbies watch Mark go for a ride on his pony Topus. Po goes on a journey; she says goodbye to Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa and sets off on her scooter. Po goes a long, long, long way before it is time for her to go home.
Some children play a game called oranges and lemons. A bell appears in Teletubbyland and makes a lovely ringing noise. The noise is so loud it makes the Tubbies fall over laughing
The Teletubbies run up to see Debbie and some children singing some songs. A voice trumpet appears and plays a game with Po and Tinky Winky. It's called 'Two Little Teletubbies Sitting On A Hill.

The Teletubbies have their favourite things, but where's Po's scooter? The Teletubbies and a group of children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty buzzy bee.

Left in charge of a wild-animal ranch, Jaime must protect a tame lion from ranchers who suspect it of killing livestock.
Jaime and Steve team up to stop a missile attack on Los Angeles launched from within the United States.
Jaime goes undercover in a beauty pageant Oscar suspects is linked to threats against national security.
Jaime sees a woman (Barbara Rush) resembling her dead mother, who Oscar admits was a Department of Defense agent.
Jaime dodges saboteurs while navigating in a desert auto race to retrieve a cassette vital to U.S. security.
An Indian boy, prone to telling stories, is Jaime's only hope when she is captured by men planning to steal a flying suit.
Jaime, posing as a stewardess, Rudy Wells and other airline passengers are stranded on a remote beach with a killer.
Jaime is jailed in a frame-up after giving a decoding device to a man posing as a general.
Jaime works as governess to a scientist's daughter (Kristy McNichol) so she can safeguard the researcher's current project.
Alien-controlled Bigfoot attacks Jaime as she tries to rescue Steve; guests John Saxon, Stefanie Powers.
Jaime deals blackjack aboard a floating casino carrying unstable, explosive energy-cell prototypes.
Jaime competes as a professional lady wrestler while searching for a missing OSI agent.
Jaime poses as a singer to find out what happened to a missing OSI agent.
A scientist (John Houseman) coveting an OSI device replaces agency secretaries with robot doubles.
After having Jaime brutally beaten, Franklin lures Steve Austin into the clutches of his robot women.

Once a prosperous silver mining camp, Aspen evolved into a year-round mountain retreat for the rich and famous. It was a place where the powerful could forget the hustle and bustle of their hectic lives.
When three visitors to Signal Mountain are murdered in the woods, suspicion falls on Frank Casteel, who liked to threaten trespassers with his shotgun.
It was September in Biloxi and summer's heat was just beginning to fade when a killer entered the home of attorney Vince Sherry and his politically active wife, Margaret.
A college student living in a fantasy world and obsessed with the game Dungeons and Dragons is charged with the brutal murder of his stepfather in North Carolina.
The story of one of the most shocking crimes in modern American history--the murders of five members of the Communist Workers' Party by Ku Klux Klansmen and American Nazis in 1979.
In the early morning of March 7, 1986, multi-millionaire Stan Cohen was shot three times in the head with his own gun as he slept in his Miami mansion.

Life in the town of Duchesne, about 100 miles from Salt Lake City, is as hard as sun-baked rock and weather-beaten leather. Everyone must struggle to survive, except John Pinder, the ne'er-do-well son of a millionaire.

Terror sweeps through an upscale Houston, Texas shopping district when a shooter attacks women without warning. A lucky break leads police to a ruthless killer who will stop at nothing to unleash a deep-seeded hatred.
Who hired the hitman that killed Alice McArthur in Little Rock, Arkansas in 1982? Was it her criminal defense attorney husband or his mistress Mary Lee Orsini?
In an instant it was over. 49-year-old Larry Volk was shot in the head as he fixed his car in the hot Nevada sun.

Atlantic City. The Las Vegas of the Eastern seaboard. Home of the Miss America Pageant. It's a town of good times and easy money. A town where corruption is big business and the battle against the mob is a daily struggle.
A church-going town is shocked when a popular minister is caught up in a scandal involving sex, betrayal, and double murder.
Home to Disneyland and John Wayne Airport, Orange County, California is a bedrock of America-pie, conservative values.

Hours after a jealous stripper vows revenge, her two-timing boyfriend is shot and killed. But the girlfriend is not the shooter, and it's up to Detective Tom Kulesa of Phoenix PD to unravel the mystery.
When Phoenix homicide Detective Tom Kulesa realizes a potential witness to a double murder has gone missing, he must race against time to stop another vicious killing.

On Graham's festive sofa are: football legend David Beckham, from 'Star Wars: The Force Awakens', Princess Leia herself Carrie Fisher and new stars Daisy Ridley and John Boyega, and pop superstar Kylie Minogue, who chats and sings.

Among the guests on Graham's sofa tonight: Hollywood megastar Harrison Ford, starring in new sci-fi adventure 'Ender's Game'; top comedian Jack Whitehall; and music and chat from James Blunt, who performs 'Bonfire Heart'.
On Graham's sofa are Oscar-winning actress and writer Emma Thompson, starring in new movie 'Saving Mr Banks'; 'Doctor Who' stars Matt Smith and David Tennant.

In Philadelphia, a down-and-out boxer (Martin Kove) rescues Banner from muggers.
Banner sees an heiress's stepmother administer a drug to her; guests William Daniels, Gerald McRaney.
In Philadelphia, a down-and-out boxer (Martin Kove) rescues Banner from muggers.
While working at a zoo, Banner finds a scientist engaged in genetic research.
The Hulk and a young boy (Brandon Cruz) must land a jetliner.
At a New Mexico track, Banner helps a race driver's mentally impaired brother; guest Gerald McRaney.
Banner finds love with a psychiatrist (Mariette Hartley) with a problem of her own.
Residents of a dying resort town create their own Hulk to attract tourists.

A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

p.t: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
p.d: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.
CI: Coroner Investigator will reveal the most in-depth look to date into the science of death.

p.t: The New Detectives: Trial By Fire
p.d: At a crime scene, anything left behind or seemingly out of place is considered a clue. But a fire can extinguish everything in its path challenging forensic investigators at every turn and making each arson a trial by fire.
Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

p.t: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
p.d: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.
This show profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts as they work to tell the stories of the young men who went to war (from the French and Indian war to Vietnam) and never came back.
Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.
The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce  with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.
In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.
When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

p.t: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
p.d: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.
Sometimes when a death seems to be accidental or the result of a tragic accident, it is up to forensic scientists to reveal the deception lying just below the surface.

Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.
Cyril reunites with an old friend who inspires him musically. Given another chance to perform, Cyril must overcome pride and doubt while reconnecting with a part of himself he had long forgotten.
A flight contest sparks Ralph’s determination to impress Melissa. As he competes, he learns that winning her respect requires honesty and effort, not grand gestures or risky stunts.
Cyril agrees to watch Mr. Knox’s nephew, who begins bullying Cedric. As tensions rise, Cedric must find the courage to stand up for himself, while Cyril learns responsibility comes with consequences.
Lady Baden-Baden takes a job at a café, surprising everyone. Mr. Knox struggles with his feelings, while the change in status leads to humorous and heartfelt moments about dignity and independence.

Bert and Cedric explore an island but fail to tell anyone, becoming stranded. As the gang searches desperately, they must rely on teamwork and clues to locate their missing friends before time runs out.
Bert falls for Lisa and builds unrealistic expectations. As he navigates his feelings, he learns that relationships require honesty and patience rather than fantasy and assumptions.
While researching family history, Bert and Cedric find adoption papers and suspect Cedric was adopted. The misunderstanding leads to emotional confusion until the truth finally comes to light.
A magician visits Evergreen, inspiring Bert to become an apprentice. Meanwhile, Cyril promotes his vault. As illusions and reality mix, both pursuits lead to unexpected and chaotic results.
Bentley visits and joins Bert and Cedric at their old school, which faces closure. Together, they must find a way to save it and preserve its legacy before it disappears for good.
Cyril pushes himself to impress Cedric with a science project, going too far. Meanwhile, Bert discovers fossils. Both stories highlight the balance between ambition and responsibility.
One of the pigs turns to theft to impress others, while Cyril and Knox compete in business. The situation spirals until lessons about honesty and self-worth come to light.
While staging a play, Cyril believes his theater is haunted. Strange events cause panic, but the truth behind the “ghost” reveals a more grounded explanation.
The pigs hire a reporter to expose Cyril, while Bert reflects on past adventures. As secrets surface, Cyril’s reputation hangs in the balance amid growing tension.
Cyril pursues a romance that quickly becomes complicated. Meanwhile, Bert and Cedric face fears during skydiving, learning to overcome anxiety in different ways.
Cyril is hospitalized, leaving the pigs in charge of a major deal. Chaos ensues, while Bert tries to recover money from a bad purchase, leading to parallel struggles with responsibility.
The ladies discuss some of the season's antics; Joanna and Lisa's friendship goes sour; Adriana continues to defend herself.
After Joanna makes accusations about her, Lisa is in attack mode; Marysol Patton visits and adds her insight.

Ashley finally gives Michael an ultimatum on having a baby; reality starts to set in for Candiace that she is about to be an instant stepmother; Robyn throws a birthday party for her youngest son; a new family member makes a special appearance.

The women revisit this season's emotional highs and lows while trying to mend their fractured friendships; Monique and Robyn get to the core of their rivalry; Candiace reveals intimate details about her relationship; Karen sheds light on her life.

The husbands join the women on stage; Karen goes after Michael; Ray explains the rumors about his wife's infidelity; Gizelle opens up about the new man in her life; Ashley reveals big news about her relationship with Michael.

Brandi and Stephanie reveal that a summer-long feud has ended their friendship; an old police report about LeeAnne's past comes to light; everything comes to a head at Cary's birthday party for Mark, where Brandi and Stephanie come face to face.

Stephanie tries to put a dent in Brandi's newfound friendship with LeeAnne; Travis drops millions on a house; D'Andra seeks to take over her mother's cosmetics business; Brandi and Stephanie meet again at the Howl-O-Ween dog costume contest.

Brandi and Stephanie attempt to repair their broken friendship; D'Andra tries not to be an evil stepmother to Jeremy's 20-year-old son; LeeAnne shows up at Stephanie's Halloween party dressed to kill.

Stephanie draws a line in the sand with Travis over expensive renovations; Brandi overhears LeeAnne gossiping about Stephanie; D'Andra demands to know when her mother will turn over the business; Brandi's invitation sparks a fight about manners.
Gamble hosts a glamorous murder-mystery party, during which she makes a big announcement; Janet and Chyka overshadow Gamble's news with revelations of their own.

Jackie and Ben craft a creative marketing pitch for La Mascara; tensions between Janet and Gamble come to a head at a fashion event; Chyka's daughter, Chessie, and Janet's friend, Manuela, meet the others.

Pettifleur spoils her son, Nathan, on a shopping spree; Jackie plays wingman as Janet tries speed dating; Chyka hosts a flower-filled Chef's Dinner party to which all the women are invited along with their plus ones.
The housewives head to Sydney, where Gamble introduces them to her sister, Tempest, and to high-profile friends at an event at the Billich Art Gallery.

p.d: After escaping from dimensional limbo, the Fly (alias Baxter Stockman) and his computer companion Z employ an experimental solid-energy generator to take over Channel Six.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Raphael Knocks 'Em Dead!
p.d: House of Ha comedians are disappearing, right in the middle of their acts.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Bebop and Rocksteady Conquer the Universe
p.d: When Bebop and Rocksteady steal the Anxietron Ray, they use it to scare the dickens out of everyone in their path, including the Turtles.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Raphael Meets His Match
p.d: Billionaire McDonald Crump makes the smallest pizzas in the world, and gives the biggest parties.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Slash - The Evil Turtles from Dimension X
p.d: Using some of Shredder's and Krang's supercharged mutagen, Bebop and Rocksteady turn pet turtle Slash into an evil super mutant.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Leonardo Lightens Up
p.d: Tired of constant nagging about discipline, Raphael, Michelangelo and Donatello use a Personality Modifier on Leonardo to get him to lighten up.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Were-Rats of Channel Six
p.d: Finding a canister of unstable mutagen, the Rat King turns April and Vernon of Channel Six News into giant were-rats. As the transformed newshounds terrorize the city, Bebop and Rocksteady arrive to collect some explosives for Shredder and Krang.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Funny-They Shrunk Michelangelo
p.d: Talbot Breech is short, fussy and the insane inventor of a shrinking ray. His hobby is to miniaturize the biggest ships afloat; only today, he's caught Michelangelo in his diabolical ray.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Big Zipp Attack!
p.d: Intent on stealing the Lofty Tower's rigidium spire, Shredder lets a dreaded Zipp loose on the city as a tactical diversion.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Donatello Makes Time
p.d: Donatello's newest invention, the Time Stopper, has fallen into the hands of unconventional scientist Lloyd Cycloyd.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Farewell, Lotus Blossom
p.d: Using a devious deception, Shredder tricks Lotus Blossom into fighting the Turtles for possession of the burial urn of Chakahachi, an ancient Japanese magician.
In a dark plot to rule the world, Dr. Polidorius has created a man-fish using an evolution accelerator.
When multi-billionaire J. Gordon Hungerdunger sponsors a superhero competition, the city goes crazy with good guys.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Michelangelo Meets Bugman
p.d: Meet Bugman: he's Michelangelo's favourite comic book mutant superhero of all time. And today, he's real and in trouble.

p.t: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1987): Poor Little Rich Turtle
p.d: Desperate for the formula to Shellhammer Chemical's super rocket fuel, Krang and Shredder send Rocksteady and Bebop to kidnap poor little rich brat Buffy Shellhammer.
Andrew comes to the rescue of a marriage that is starting off on the wrong foot.
After her mother dies, 10-year-old Danni Blake is determined to find the father she never knew.
An eternal optimist, with help from the Angels, plans a family vacation for her daughter and son-in-law hopes of strengthening their marriage.
The angels unite to help Reggie, a man who has always considered himself a failure, deal with a secret.
The angels assist a couple that can't have children with the adoption of a Chinese baby girl.
Each angel plays a pivotal role in helping a family deal with the sudden death of a loved one.
The Angels attempt to reunite a father and son before an asteroid destroys planet Earth.
With the help of the Angels, an average man who performs an act of great heroism and gains fleeting fame.
The Angels must band together to combat Monique, Monica's evil twin, and prevent her from breaking up a marriage.
The Angels help a teenage girl who suffers from Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD) and her father overcome their obstacles.
The Angels help a dying woman try to find a guardian for her daughter.
The Angels come to the aid of a lonely man who doesn't want to return a runaway girl to her father.
The Angels teach three different couples the meaning of love on Valentine's Day.
The Angels help another Angel who has lost her faith find her way back to heaven.
The Angels help a young singer in danger of losing her vocal chords find her true voice.
In the light of day, a DNA picture painted by a molecular biologist and new clues are revealed about a traffic accident during the night.
Blood spatters can be used to help solve cases, especially when things may not appear to be what seem. Find out how forensics pieced together the evidence to crack this case.
Police initially thought a teenager had run away, until they found her naked battered body in a ditch. They hope to find the killer with the evidence.
Police recovered a submerged car, but the driver was missing. Evidence found inside the car would lead them down a trail of obsession.
In California, an innocent couple were found shot dead in a car park. As detectives investigated, they discovered their deaths were part of a murderous plot targeting law enforcement.
With no evidence, detectives were stuck investigating the missing expectant mother, but the spring thaw exposed a flaw in a sinister scheme.
In the 1980s, a series of women went missing in Anchorage, Alaska, leading local and state police to collaborate in their hunt for the predator.
In June 2010, North Attleborough police are summoned to a brutal homicide scene. Minutes later, an impending thunderstorm threatens to obliterate crucial evidence.
During the frigid winter of 2018 in Idaho, police receive a frantic phone call. A man has reportedly fallen overboard into freezing waters.
In San Antonio, Christopher Duncan leaves his apartment never to return home. Police have little to go on until surveillance footage offers up the possible identity of a dangerous killer.
In 2016, car salesman Hufracio Arteaga was found stabbed to death in his Michigan City office, and surveillance cameras from a nearby building could potentially help investigators reveal the killer.

In 2015 care worker Torrance Cheeves is found stabbed to death in his Texas home. With no suspects and a trail of puzzling evidence, investigators turn to surveillance cameras in the surrounding area for answers.

When 12-year-old Alajawan Brown is gunned down outside a 7-Eleven in Skyway, Washington, close to an earlier shooting, the police refer to CCTV footage to help put together pieces of the puzzle and find the killer.
In the 1990s, electrician Tony Teare lured Corrine Bentley to remote moorland in the UK, promising her a job. In the violent attack that followed, he left her for dead.
Already a wanted criminal in Canada, fraudster Albert Walker fled to the UK and assumed the identity of a man who would become his business partner - Ronald Platt.

Tuna.com continues its winning streak, catching two fish in one day while the rest of the fleet struggles to even find a spot to fish in between the weekend recreational boaters.

Marciano, captain of Hard Merchandise, risks the elements to hook a giant bluefin and finds himself with boat trouble in the midst of the storm.

The drought finally throws up a fire and the wedding turns into a firefight for everyone. The omens are bad.
Tragedy strikes and the Trevanians have to decide what future lies ahead of them in these difficult times.

It's a year since we left Leopard's Den and much has changed. The animal hospital has been rebuilt and is now up and running. It's a big day for all the family as Danny has been fighting for custody of Evan and today they will learn the judge's decision.
Danny and Evan's life on the run doesn't start well when Danny falls asleep at the wheel and drives into a ditch. They have to enlist a local farmer, Johann, to winch them out.

Danny is asked by the State Vet to help control an outbreak of rabies in the National Park. When Vanessa is concerned for the animals at Mara, Danny assures her it's a long way away and advises her to continue with business as usual.

It's the day before Rosie's wedding. Danny is proud of his daughter and determined to feed her up now that she's eating for two. All the family are excited about the imminent return of Caroline, especially Du Plessis who can't wait to see his fiancé.
Alice and Danny are called out by a farmer who's trapped an African Wild Dog. As they're even more endangered than cheetahs and much more vicious, Danny and Alice are amazed to see one up close.
When Du Plessis instructs the family to be around for dinner, they are intrigued to hear he's planning a big announcement. However, he won't be drawn on details and tells them to be patient.
Alice and Danny are delighted when the Animal Hospital is given responsibility for the rescue and conservation of animals in the region – it's a big achievement after all their hard work.
Danny and Alice are concerned about a missing male giraffe but Du Plessis is confident he can find him. He's as good as his word but they're upset to discover Mara lions have killed the giraffe.

The family frantically dig for Charlotte in the rubble, hoping that somehow she has survived. Rowan arrives and takes charge of the situation, directing them to be more methodical in their rescue efforts.
Danny and Alice are enjoying being together but agree to keep their relationship under wraps for the moment. However, they're unaware Georgina has heard their every word!

Danny and Alice's project to re-habilitate a group of circus elephants has been a huge success but now they have too many elephants on Leopard's Den, so they urgently need to move the circus herd to the National Park.

Leopard's Den is helping to build a new school in the township but when Danny hurts his back he begins to have a crisis about his age. Danny and Alice are surprised when Vanessa comes to them for advice.

Mara is hosting a beauty pageant and Rowan realises he needs all the publicity he can get. He buys a tiger from a zoo and convinces Alice he plans to rehabilitate it. Alice is enjoying working with her brother and even defends him to Danny.

p.t: History's Greatest Aircraft: HE-111: Germany’s Frontline Bomber
